Small ways of proving you've got each other.
Finding out you both wondered about the same thing.

items.title: A Promise
items.subtitle: Something for later.
items.body: Send one message that promises something for the next time you are together, specific enough that they will think about it all day.

items.title: Across the Room
items.subtitle: Catch their eye.
items.body: Stand at opposite ends of the room and flirt using only your eyes until one of you laughs or gives in and crosses over.

items.title: Bad Ideas
items.subtitle: The best kind.
items.body: List three 'bad ideas' you would like to have with them tonight. They veto one. The other two are fair game.

items.title: Bold Admission
items.subtitle: The thing you almost said.
items.body: Tell them something you almost said to them this week and stopped yourself. Say it now, exactly as it came to you.

items.title: Bolder Than Last Time
items.subtitle: Raise it once.
items.body: Remind them of the boldest thing either of you has said to the other. Now say one thing that goes a little further.

items.title: Borrowed Line
items.subtitle: From a film, a song, anywhere.
items.body: Flirt with them using only lines borrowed from songs or films. They have to guess where each one came from.

items.title: Caught Staring
items.subtitle: Don't pretend you weren't.
items.body: Stare at them until they notice. When they ask what you are looking at, tell them the truth, in full.

items.title: Closer, Closer
items.subtitle: One step per compliment.
items.body: Start across the room. Every compliment they give you lets them take one step closer. You decide when they have earned the last one.

items.title: Code Word
items.subtitle: Say it without saying it.
items.body: Agree on an innocent word that secretly means 'I want you'. Both of you use it at least three times tonight in completely ordinary sentences.

items.title: Compliment Storm
items.subtitle: Ten in ten minutes.
items.body: Send ten compliments over ten minutes, one at a time, and not one of them about how they look.

items.title: Dare Me
items.subtitle: Anything, within your limits.
items.body: Each of you writes one bold dare for the other, inside the limits you have both set. Trade papers, read them in silence, and do them.

items.title: Dare or Compliment
items.subtitle: Pick one. Every time.
items.body: Take turns asking 'dare or compliment?'. Compliments must be specific; dares must be sweet enough to say yes to.

items.title: Describe the Kiss
items.subtitle: Before it happens.
items.body: Describe, in detail, the kiss you are about to give them. Where it starts, how long it lasts. Then give them exactly that.

items.title: Dream Date
items.subtitle: Money is no object.
items.body: Describe the date you would plan for them if nothing got in the way. They score it out of ten and pick the part they want first.

items.title: Favourite Angle
items.subtitle: The one that gets you.
items.body: Tell them which of their angles is your favourite, and exactly what it does to you when they turn that way.

items.title: First Kiss, Again
items.subtitle: The version you wish had happened.
items.body: Recreate your first kiss as closely as you can remember: where you stood, what was said. Then do the version you wish had happened.

items.title: First Look
items.subtitle: Where it started.
items.body: Tell them the very first thing you noticed about them. The real first thing, not the polite version. Then ask for theirs.

items.title: Good Morning, Gorgeous
items.subtitle: Start their day.
items.body: Send the first message of their morning: one line about what you would do if you woke up next to them today.

items.title: Goodnight, Out Loud
items.subtitle: So they can hear you smile.
items.body: Record thirty seconds telling them what you would do if you were there to say goodnight in person. Send it as a voice note.

items.title: Hands Talk
items.subtitle: No words for a minute.
items.body: For one minute, communicate only through your hands on theirs. Afterwards, say what you think they were trying to tell you.

items.title: Hold the Gaze
items.subtitle: Two minutes. No looking away.
items.body: Hold eye contact for two full minutes while you tell them what you want from tonight. They are not allowed to answer until the time is up.

items.title: Kiss Countdown
items.subtitle: Ten seconds. Then closer.
items.body: Stand close enough to kiss, and don't. Count down from ten together, slowly. Whoever breaks first owes the other a favour.

items.title: Kiss Review
items.subtitle: Five stars, or a rewrite.
items.body: Kiss them, then give that kiss a review out of five, with notes. They get another go, taking your feedback into account.

items.title: Late Night, Your Voice
items.subtitle: Just for them.
items.body: Record two minutes of your voice telling them what you are thinking about as you get into bed tonight. Keep it true. Keep it theirs.

items.title: Lover's Trivia
items.subtitle: What do you really know?
items.body: Ask each other three questions only a lover could answer. Every right answer earns a kiss. Every wrong one earns a dare of their choosing.

items.title: Low Voice
items.subtitle: Slower than feels natural.
items.body: Record yourself reading something ordinary, like the weather forecast, in the lowest, slowest voice you have. Send it and let them decide what it made them think of.

items.title: Make Them Blush
items.subtitle: Words only.
items.body: You have sixty seconds to make them blush using only words. They have to keep a straight face for as long as they can.

items.title: No Filter
items.subtitle: Five minutes of honesty.
items.body: For five minutes, say every flirtatious thought about them the moment you have it. No filter, no editing, no taking anything back.

items.title: No Hands
items.subtitle: Only words.
items.body: For five minutes, you may not touch them at all. Only your words are allowed to do the work. Then the rule ends.

items.title: One Rule
items.subtitle: They set it. You keep it.
items.body: They choose one rule you must keep while flirting with them for ten minutes: only questions, only whispers, or no hands at all.

items.title: Opening Line
items.subtitle: Message them like you've only just matched.
items.body: Send them the message you would send if you had only just matched and wanted a first date. They reply like they are still deciding.

items.title: Proud of You
items.subtitle: Say it properly.
items.body: Tell them about a moment you were quietly proud of them and never said so. Say it now, properly, like it deserves.

items.title: Flirt Rating
items.subtitle: Out of ten, with notes.
items.body: Flirt with them for one minute as outrageously as you can. They give you a score out of ten and one note for improvement. Try again.

items.title: Say It Slowly
items.subtitle: Every word counts.
items.body: Tell them what you want from them next, one word at a time, with a pause between each. They may not move until you finish.

items.title: Yes, Yes, Maybe
items.subtitle: Answer quickly.
items.body: Take turns suggesting bold ideas for later, quick-fire. The other answers only 'yes', 'maybe' or 'not tonight'. No reasons required.

items.title: Our Best Night
items.subtitle: Tell it like a story.
items.body: Retell your best night together as a story told to them, in the second person, lingering on the parts you still think about.

items.title: Secret Nickname
items.subtitle: One only you use.
items.body: Invent a nickname for them that nobody could guess the meaning of. Tell them the story behind it, then use it for the rest of the night.

items.title: Slow Song
items.subtitle: Pick it. Play it. Move.
items.body: Choose a song you would slow dance to with them. Play it and dance, even if it is only swaying in the kitchen with the lights low.

items.title: Sultry Story
items.subtitle: One sentence each.
items.body: Tell a story about the two of you tonight, one sentence each. It has to get a little bolder with every sentence.

items.title: Tell Me Something
items.subtitle: Start with 'I like it when you...'
items.body: Finish the sentence 'I like it when you...' five times without stopping. They pick their favourite and you explain it.

items.title: Tell Me What You Want
items.subtitle: Three wants. Clearly.
items.body: Take turns naming one thing you want from the other tonight. No hints, no hedging, and no laughing it off.

items.title: Tell Them Everything
items.subtitle: The whole plan.
items.body: Tell them, unhurried and in detail, exactly how you want tonight to end. They listen without interrupting, then choose where to start.

items.title: The Plan
items.subtitle: Tell them what's coming.
items.body: Message them the plan for the next time you are alone together, step by step. They may add one step, and remove none.

items.title: The Confident One
items.subtitle: Act like you already know.
items.body: Flirt with them as if you already know exactly how tonight ends, because you do. Keep it up until they admit it too.

items.title: The Detail
items.subtitle: The thing nobody notices.
items.body: Name one small thing about them you love that you are fairly sure nobody has ever noticed. Say when you first saw it.

items.title: The Last Word
items.subtitle: End the night on it.
items.body: End the night by telling them one sentence you want them to remember tomorrow. Make it the boldest true thing you can say.

items.title: The List
items.subtitle: Ranked, honestly.
items.body: Write a list of the five things about them that drive you wild. Rank them. Read the list out loud, starting from number five.

items.title: The Look
items.subtitle: Send the face.
items.body: Send them a photo of the exact expression you would make if they walked through the door right now. No caption. No explanation.

items.title: The Moment
items.subtitle: When did it start tonight?
items.body: Tell them the moment tonight you first wanted them: what they were doing, and what you did not say at the time.

items.title: The Once-Over
items.subtitle: Take your time.
items.body: Look them up and down, slowly, and describe what you see as if it were a painting you intend to own.

items.title: The Photo They'd Ask For
items.subtitle: Tasteful. Unmistakable.
items.body: Send the photo you think they most want from you right now: tasteful, suggestive, and entirely your choice what it shows.

items.title: Their Turn to Decide
items.subtitle: You offer. They choose.
items.body: Offer them three bold ways to spend the next ten minutes. They choose one without explaining. You make it happen.

items.title: Three Compliments
items.subtitle: Specific, or it doesn't count.
items.body: Give them three compliments, each more specific than the last. The last one should be something you have never said out loud.

items.title: Three Words, Then Proof
items.subtitle: Say it. Then show it.
items.body: Describe them in three words, then show them what each word means without speaking at all.

items.title: Tonight, Precisely
items.subtitle: What would make it perfect?
items.body: Tell them what would make tonight perfect, in as much detail as you dare. They pick one thing from your list to make happen.

items.title: Turn It Up
items.subtitle: Every line bolder than the last.
items.body: Take turns flirting, each line a little bolder than the last. The first to laugh or look away has to go again.

items.title: Undivided
items.subtitle: Nothing else exists.
items.body: Put every screen away. For five minutes, they have your complete attention: every word, every look, every touch is theirs.

items.title: Wardrobe Report
items.subtitle: Describe it like it matters.
items.body: Describe what you are wearing right now in the most flattering, cinematic way you can manage. They describe theirs back, even if it is pyjamas.

items.title: If You Were Here
items.subtitle: Start the sentence. Finish it properly.
items.body: Send three messages that each begin 'If you were here right now...'. Each one a little bolder than the last.

items.title: What You Do to Me
items.subtitle: Say it plainly.
items.body: Tell them, plainly and without softening it, what they do to you when they look at you a certain way.

items.title: Whisper It
items.subtitle: Closer.
items.body: Lean in and whisper a compliment you would never say at a normal volume. Pull back and hold their eyes until they answer.

items.title: Worst Line Wins
items.subtitle: Your cheesiest opener.
items.body: Take turns delivering the most shameless pickup line you can invent, fully committed. Whoever laughs first has to deliver theirs again, slower.

items.title: Worth the Wait
items.subtitle: They get the last word.
items.body: Send them a message describing the moment you will next see them in unhurried detail. End it mid-sentence. They finish it.

items.title: All Day Long
items.subtitle: Starts at breakfast.
items.body: From breakfast until you are alone tonight, drop one bold hint every few hours about how tonight will go. Deliver on every one.

items.title: Almost Everything
items.subtitle: Leave one thing out.
items.body: Give them almost everything they ask for tonight. Keep one thing back, and tell them it is saved for next time.

items.title: The Almost Kiss
items.subtitle: Stop just short.
items.body: Lean in as if to kiss them and stop a breath away. Hold it for five seconds, smile, and walk off to make them a cup of tea.

items.title: Not Yet
items.subtitle: Their favourite words, by the end.
items.body: Every time they reach for you in the next five minutes, the answer is 'not yet'. Make each 'not yet' more convincing than the last.

items.title: Closer by the Hour
items.subtitle: One message each hour.
items.body: Describe your evening together hour by hour in messages, from the moment you meet to the moment you both stop talking. Send one each hour.

items.title: Five Messages
items.subtitle: Each bolder than the last.
items.body: Send five messages over the next half hour. Each one hints at what you want next time a little more boldly than the one before.

items.title: The Withheld Compliment
items.subtitle: They have to earn the end.
items.body: Start a compliment, 'The thing I find most irresistible about you is...', and stop. They have to earn the ending.

items.title: Countdown
items.subtitle: Only numbers.
items.body: Text them a single number every hour until you next see them, counting down. No context. Let them work it out.

items.title: Hours Until You
items.subtitle: Every message, closer.
items.body: On the day you will see each other, send a message every two hours describing a little more of what happens when you do.

items.title: The Blurred Photo
items.subtitle: Detail comes later.
items.body: Send them a photo taken slightly out of focus with the caption 'the clear one comes later'. Keep your promise, eventually.

items.title: Describe, Then Wait
items.subtitle: Words first. Everything else later.
items.body: Describe, in a low voice, exactly what you are going to do next. Then make them wait a full minute before you do any of it.

items.title: Dessert First
items.subtitle: Taste, slowly.
items.body: Share something sweet, one bite at a time, fed to each other. Nobody is allowed to use their own hands.

items.title: The Signal
items.subtitle: Agree it now. Use it later.
items.body: Agree on a small signal, a touch or a word, that means 'take me home now'. Use it once this week, somewhere ordinary.

items.title: What I'm Wearing Later
items.subtitle: One detail only.
items.body: Tell them one detail of what you will be wearing when you next see them. One detail. Let their imagination do the rest.

items.title: Edge of the Bed
items.subtitle: Stay there.
items.body: They sit on the edge of the bed and stay there while you take your time deciding how close to come. They may ask. You may refuse.

items.title: The Envelope
items.subtitle: Open it later.
items.body: Write them a short note, seal it, and hand it over with one rule: they cannot open it until tomorrow morning.

items.title: The Forbidden Word
items.subtitle: Say it and lose.
items.body: Pick a word neither of you may say for the rest of the night. Whoever slips up hands the other one bold request, within your limits.

items.title: Guess the Song
items.subtitle: Hum it close.
items.body: Hum a song that reminds you of them, close to their ear. They get three guesses. Each wrong guess, you hum a little closer.

items.title: Hands-Off Dance
items.subtitle: Close, never touching.
items.body: Dance to one song as close to each other as possible without touching at all. The first to give in chooses the next song.

items.title: Hands to Yourself
items.subtitle: Words only.
items.body: For five minutes they may not touch you, and you may only tell them what you would be doing if they could.

items.title: Seek and Find
items.subtitle: A kiss for the finder.
items.body: Hide somewhere in the room with a kiss as the prize. You are allowed to hum to help. They are allowed to cheat.

items.title: Just There
items.subtitle: Nowhere else.
items.body: Kiss them only along their neck and shoulders for two minutes. Anywhere else is off limits, however much they complain.

items.title: Look, Don't Touch
items.subtitle: Two minutes. Hands behind the back.
items.body: They keep their hands behind their back for two minutes while you get as close as you like without touching. Then trade places.

items.title: Make Them Ask
items.subtitle: Nicely.
items.body: Do not do the thing they want until they ask for it out loud, in a full sentence, nicely. Then make them ask once more.

items.title: Maybe Later
items.subtitle: The most annoying words.
items.body: Next time they reach for a kiss, say 'maybe later' with a straight face. Keep them waiting exactly as long as you can stand it.

items.title: Mirror Game
items.subtitle: Copy everything.
items.body: Face each other. For three minutes they must copy every move you make, slowly. Make it as difficult to keep a straight face as you can.

items.title: Near Miss
items.subtitle: Almost. Not yet.
items.body: For the next ten minutes, let your hand almost touch theirs, and never quite. Pretend it is an accident every time.

items.title: Not Until
items.subtitle: The condition is theirs to meet.
items.body: Tell them what they get tonight, and one small condition they must meet first. Make the condition charming and slightly difficult.

items.title: One Clue a Day
items.subtitle: Something is coming.
items.body: Tell them something is coming this week. Give them one clue a day. The last clue arrives with the thing itself.

items.title: One-Word Requests
items.subtitle: Whispered. Obeyed.
items.body: For five minutes, you may only speak to them in single whispered words: slower, closer, stay, now. They do as you ask, within your limits.

items.title: Pick a Card
items.subtitle: Face down. Every card counts.
items.body: Write four bold ideas on four scraps of paper and lay them face down. They pick one. Nobody sees the other three, ever.

items.title: Track Three
items.subtitle: From the top, no skipping.
items.body: Send them a five-song playlist to play from the top, no skipping. Track three is a message. Do not tell them which part.

items.title: Seen
items.subtitle: Let them wonder.
items.body: Send them a message that just says 'I've been thinking about you. A lot.' Do not answer their reply for twenty minutes.

items.title: Remote Tease
items.subtitle: They can't do anything about it.
items.body: While they are busy, send them one message so bold they have to put their phone face-down for a minute. Say nothing else.

items.title: Two-Line Riddle
items.subtitle: What are you planning?
items.body: Send them a two-line riddle about something you have planned for the two of you. They get one guess per hour.

items.title: One Place Only
items.subtitle: Choose carefully.
items.body: Choose the one place they are allowed to touch you for the next five minutes. You may change your mind whenever you like.

items.title: Sealed Instructions
items.subtitle: Opened on your signal.
items.body: Write three sealed notes with one instruction each. They open one whenever you tap the table, and follow it, within the limits you both agreed.

items.title: Secret Smile
items.subtitle: Don't tell them why.
items.body: Smile at them for no reason, every time they look over, for the next half hour. Never explain. Deny everything.

items.title: Their Secret Task
items.subtitle: Complete it before midnight.
items.body: Give them one small, private task to complete for you before midnight, written on a folded note. They do not get to ask why.

items.title: Slow Goodnight
items.subtitle: Longest goodnight ever.
items.body: Say goodnight to them in six separate messages, each a little more reluctant to end the conversation than the last.

items.title: Slow Reply
items.subtitle: Make them wait for it.
items.body: For the next half hour, reply to their messages a little slower each time, and a little sweeter. Let the waiting do the flirting.

items.title: Stop and Start
items.subtitle: You call it.
items.body: Kiss them, and every ten seconds say 'stop'. Wait until they lean in again before you say 'go'.

items.title: Leading Questions
items.subtitle: Answer only yes or no.
items.body: Ask them five leading questions about what they want tonight. They may only answer yes or no, and you may only look pleased.

items.title: Tell You Later
items.subtitle: The four worst words.
items.body: Say 'I will tell you later what I was just thinking about you', and then don't, until they have asked at least three times.

items.title: Where Your Hands Would Be
items.subtitle: Tell them, slowly.
items.body: Message them where your hands would be if you were next to them right now, one message at a time, a minute apart.

items.title: Unfinished Sentence
items.subtitle: Stop mid-way.
items.body: Tell them, very close to their ear, 'I keep imagining you...' and stop there. Change the subject. Finish it when you decide.

items.title: The Long Way Round
items.subtitle: No shortcuts allowed.
items.body: Take twice as long as you want to over every kiss for the next ten minutes. If they try to hurry, start again from the beginning.

items.title: The Longest Minute
items.subtitle: Nothing happens. Everything does.
items.body: Hold them, completely still, for one full minute without kissing. Breathe together. Then let the minute end however you both want it to.

items.title: Pocket Note
items.subtitle: Found later.
items.body: Slip a note somewhere they will find it later today: a pocket, a bag, under their phone. One line, unsigned, unmistakably yours.

items.title: The Pause
items.subtitle: Right in the middle.
items.body: In the middle of a kiss, pull back and ask them something completely mundane, like what they want for breakfast. Wait for the answer. Then carry on.

items.title: Rain Check
items.subtitle: Promise, then wait.
items.body: Promise them something specific and a little bold, then call a rain check. Name the day you will make good on it.

items.title: A Rumour About You
items.subtitle: Made up, flattering, specific.
items.body: Invent a flattering, slightly scandalous rumour about them and deliver it like the best gossip you have ever heard.

items.title: Slow Reveal
items.subtitle: One layer at a time.
items.body: Reveal one thing you have been saving for them, a word, an outfit, a plan, one piece at a time, with a pause they cannot rush.

items.title: The Whole Evening
items.subtitle: Tease from the first minute.
items.body: Tease them from the first minute of the evening to the last: a look, a touch, a word, never more. Make the ending worth every minute.

items.title: A Hint About Tomorrow
items.subtitle: Only a hint.
items.body: Tell them you have something planned for tomorrow. Give them one hint. Refuse every follow-up question with a kiss.

items.title: Before You Sleep
items.subtitle: Their ears only.
items.body: Leave them a voice message to play when they are alone tonight: what you are thinking about, as honestly and as slowly as you dare.

items.title: Three Things
items.subtitle: Whispered. Then nothing.
items.body: Whisper three things you want to do to them tonight. Then refuse to do any of them for ten minutes.

items.title: Whispered Plan
items.subtitle: Say it where only they hear.
items.body: Whisper one thing you intend to do to them later, then carry on as if nothing was said. Refuse to repeat it.

items.title: Wrong Answer
items.subtitle: Every wrong answer costs a kiss.
items.body: Ask them five questions about you. Every wrong answer costs them a kiss, delivered wherever you point.

items.title: You First
items.subtitle: They show you how.
items.body: Ask them to show you, slowly, exactly how they would tease you if they were in charge tonight. Then turn it back on them.

items.title: The Almost-Said
items.subtitle: Early on.
items.body: Tell them about a moment early on when you almost said something big and chickened out. What were you going to say?

items.title: Confess and Ask
items.subtitle: Then they answer.
items.body: Confess one thing you want and ask one question you have been afraid to ask. They must answer the question before the night ends.

items.title: The Night I Still Think About
items.subtitle: In detail, if you dare.
items.body: Confess which night together you still think about most, and exactly which moment of it comes back to you.

items.title: The Boldest Truth
items.subtitle: No taking it back.
items.body: Confess the boldest true thing you have ever thought about them. No softening, no joke at the end, no taking it back.

items.title: Anonymous-ish
items.subtitle: Type it. Send it. Hide.
items.body: Message them a confession you would find hard to say to their face. Then put your phone down for five minutes.

items.title: Trade
items.subtitle: One for one. Bigger each time.
items.body: Trade confessions, one for one, each bolder than the last. Either of you can stop the trade at any time, no questions asked.

items.title: Whispered Confession
items.subtitle: Say it only once.
items.body: Whisper one confession you would never say at normal volume. You say it once. They are not allowed to ask you to repeat it.

items.title: The Daydream
items.subtitle: At the worst possible moment.
items.body: Confess the last time you daydreamed about them at a completely inappropriate moment. Where were you supposed to be concentrating?

items.title: Closed Eyes, Open Secret
items.subtitle: Theirs, not yours.
items.body: They close their eyes. You confess one thing you want to do to them, and then decide whether to do it.

items.title: First Flutter
items.subtitle: Before anything happened.
items.body: Confess the first moment you felt a flutter about them, before anything had happened between you. What gave it away?

items.title: First Impression
items.subtitle: Be honest. It's funnier.
items.body: Confess what you honestly thought of them the first time you met, including the part you have never admitted.

items.title: Guilty Pleasure
items.subtitle: The ridiculous one.
items.body: Confess your most ridiculous guilty pleasure, the one you would deny in company. They have to confess one back.

items.title: The Hidden List
items.subtitle: Three items. Real ones.
items.body: Write down three bold things you would like to share with them someday. Read one aloud now. The other two wait for another night.

items.title: In the Dark
items.subtitle: Lights off. Truth on.
items.body: Turn the lights off. Take turns confessing something you want from the other that you would not say with the lights on.

items.title: Small Jealousy
items.subtitle: Harmless, and true.
items.body: Confess one completely harmless thing you are a little jealous of: their laugh, their patience, the way they sleep through anything.

items.title: After Midnight
items.subtitle: The things that only get said late.
items.body: After midnight, message them the thing you only admit late at night. They reply in the morning, in person.

items.title: Most Distracting
items.subtitle: Top of the list.
items.body: Confess the single most distracting thing they have ever done without meaning to. Tell them what went through your head.

items.title: Pretending Not to Notice
items.subtitle: You noticed.
items.body: Confess something they do that you pretend not to notice but absolutely do, every single time.

items.title: Rate the Confession
items.subtitle: One to ten.
items.body: Take turns making confessions. The other rates each one from 'mild' to 'I need a moment'. Keep going until someone reaches ten.

items.title: Deeper
items.subtitle: Keep going if you both want to.
items.body: Confess a secret. They confess one slightly deeper. Keep going while you both want to; either can end it with a kiss.

items.title: The Message You Delete
items.subtitle: Send it this time.
items.body: Confess, by message, something you have typed to them before and deleted without sending. Send it this time.

items.title: The Compliment I Kept
items.subtitle: Too much at the time.
items.body: Confess a compliment you once thought about them and kept to yourself because it felt like too much. Say it now.

items.title: What I Call You
items.subtitle: In my head.
items.body: Confess what you call them in your head when they are not listening. Explain yourself.

items.title: The Rehearsal
items.subtitle: You practised it, didn't you?
items.body: Confess something you once rehearsed saying to them before you actually said it. Perform the rehearsed version now.

items.title: The Unasked Request
items.subtitle: Something you never asked for.
items.body: Confess one thing you would love them to do more often that you have never asked for. They answer only with 'noted'.

items.title: A Wish for Us
items.subtitle: Small or huge.
items.body: Confess one wish for the two of you that you have never said out loud because it felt too soon, too big, or too silly.

items.title: What I Stare At
items.subtitle: When they're not looking.
items.body: Confess what you catch yourself staring at when they are not looking. Be specific. They will want to check.

items.title: Tell Me the Truth
items.subtitle: They pick the question.
items.body: They ask you one bold question of their choosing. You must answer truthfully or give them a kiss that explains why you won't.

items.title: The Dream
items.subtitle: The one about them.
items.body: Confess a dream you had about them. Tell them as much of it as you are willing to, and let them guess the rest.

items.title: Something I Imagined
items.subtitle: Said out loud for once.
items.body: Confess one scene you have imagined about the two of you, in as much detail as feels good, and not a word more.

items.title: The Full Truth
items.subtitle: About tonight.
items.body: Confess the full truth about what you have been imagining for tonight. Then ask them for theirs.

items.title: My Limit, and Past It
items.subtitle: Know both.
items.body: Confess one thing that is firmly outside your limits and one thing that sits right at the edge of them. Neither needs a reason.

items.title: That Look
items.subtitle: You know which one.
items.body: Confess what you are thinking when you give them that particular look, the one they have asked about before.

items.title: The One You Won't Say
items.subtitle: Say it anyway.
items.body: Everyone has one thing they would never say to their partner. Say yours, as gently or as boldly as it needs.

items.title: That Outfit
items.subtitle: You know the one.
items.body: Confess which thing they wear that you find most distracting, and one occasion it made you lose your train of thought.

items.title: The Screenshot
items.subtitle: You kept it.
items.body: Confess a message of theirs you saved, screenshotted or read more than once. Send it back to them now.

items.title: The Thought I Hide
items.subtitle: Right now, in this room.
items.body: Confess what you are actually thinking about them right now, this minute, without softening a word of it.

items.title: I Thought About It
items.subtitle: Earlier today.
items.body: Confess one moment today when you thought about them in a way that would make them blush. Describe it only as far as you dare.

items.title: The Tiny Habit
items.subtitle: The one you secretly love.
items.body: Confess one tiny habit of theirs you pretend to find annoying but secretly love. Say what it does to you.

items.title: True or Invented
items.subtitle: Confess three. One is made up.
items.body: Confess three things about how you feel about them. One is invented. They have to work out which, and why you would lie about it.

items.title: Say It in Your Voice
items.subtitle: Recorded, not typed.
items.body: Record a voice message confessing the boldest thing you have thought about them this week. They listen alone.

items.title: Small Truth, Out Loud
items.subtitle: Easier to say than type.
items.body: Record a short voice message confessing one small truth you have never got round to saying. Keep it under a minute.

items.title: Unedited
items.subtitle: Record it in one take.
items.body: Record one take, no restarts, confessing exactly what you want from them next time. Send it before you can talk yourself out of it.

items.title: What Drives Me Wild
items.subtitle: Number one.
items.body: Confess the single thing they do that drives you wildest. Then confess when they last did it, and whether they knew.

items.title: Never Asked For
items.subtitle: Until now.
items.body: Confess one thing you have wanted to try with them and never asked for. They answer honestly: yes, maybe, or not for me.

items.title: The Replay
items.subtitle: The moment you keep reliving.
items.body: Confess a moment between you that you replay in your head more often than you would admit. Tell it from your side.

items.title: What I Wanted Then
items.subtitle: At a certain dinner.
items.body: Confess a time you were out together, perfectly polite, while thinking about something entirely different. What were you thinking?

items.title: What You Don't Know
items.subtitle: About how much I want you.
items.body: Confess the thing they do not know about how much you want them: when it hits hardest, and what you do about it.

items.title: What I Want Now
items.subtitle: Present tense.
items.body: Confess what you want from them in the next ten minutes, specifically and out loud. They decide whether you get it.

items.title: When I Knew
items.subtitle: The exact moment.
items.body: Tell them the exact moment you knew you were in trouble with them, in the best way. Where were you? What were they doing?

items.title: The Kiss I Remember
items.subtitle: One stands out.
items.body: Confess which kiss between you stands out most in your memory, and the detail about it you have never mentioned.

items.title: My Worst Moment
items.subtitle: On our early dates.
items.body: Confess the moment on one of your early dates when you were most sure you had ruined everything. Were you right?

items.title: Honest Answers
items.subtitle: Five questions.
items.body: Ask each other five bold questions about your fantasies. Answer each one honestly or with a single kiss. Nobody explains a kiss.

items.title: Anywhere Tonight
items.subtitle: Teleport, one night only.
items.body: If you could take them anywhere in the world for tonight only, where would you go, and what is the first thing you would do there?

items.title: The Wild List
items.subtitle: Kept somewhere safe.
items.body: Make a list together of five bold fantasies you both want to try someday. Keep it somewhere only the two of you will ever find.

items.title: Written, Not Said
items.subtitle: Easier to write.
items.body: Message them the fantasy that is easier to write than to say. They reply with the one part they would most like to hear out loud.

items.title: The Scene, By Message
items.subtitle: One line at a time.
items.body: Build a fantasy scene together by message, one line each, taking turns. Stop the moment either of you wants to.

items.title: Only Us on the Floor
items.subtitle: The music, the lights.
items.body: Describe your fantasy dance: the room, the music, the lighting, and the exact moment you would pull them closer.

items.title: Describe the Scene
items.subtitle: Where, when, how it starts.
items.body: Describe a fantasy scene for the two of you: the place, the time of night, how it begins. They decide how it continues.

items.title: They Choose the Details
items.subtitle: You tell the story.
items.body: Start telling a fantasy. Every time you pause, they choose the next detail: where, what you are wearing, who speaks first.

items.title: You Direct It
items.subtitle: They play along.
items.body: Describe a fantasy scene and direct them through it, word by word, only as far as you both agreed beforehand.

items.title: Draft It Together
items.subtitle: Write the scene.
items.body: Write a short fantasy scene about the two of you together, one paragraph each. Read the finished version aloud in the dark.

items.title: One Room Each
items.subtitle: In the dream home.
items.body: Design one room each in your fantasy home together, down to the lighting. Explain what happens in yours.

items.title: Dress Them Up
items.subtitle: For a night out in your head.
items.body: Describe exactly what you would dress them in for your fantasy night out, and the moment you would most enjoy them wearing it.

items.title: The Ending
items.subtitle: Choose it together.
items.body: Tell a fantasy up to its best moment and stop. Decide together how it ends, and whether that ending happens tonight.

items.title: How We Should Have Met
items.subtitle: Rewrite the meeting.
items.body: Rewrite how the two of you met as a scene from a romance novel. Take turns narrating, one line each, until you reach the first kiss.

items.title: The Hotel Room
items.subtitle: Door closes. Then what?
items.body: Describe arriving at a beautiful hotel together: the view, the room, the moment the door closes. Stop there, for now.

items.title: In Detail
items.subtitle: The one you keep coming back to.
items.body: Describe the fantasy about them you keep coming back to, in as much detail as you both want. Either of you can pause it any time.

items.title: Three Words Only
items.subtitle: Describe it tightly.
items.body: Describe a fantasy night together in exactly three words. They get to ask three yes-or-no questions about it.

items.title: Midnight Story
items.subtitle: Your voice, their ears only.
items.body: Record a story for them to listen to at midnight: a fantasy about the two of you, told the way you would tell it lying next to them.

items.title: A Letter From the Fantasy
items.subtitle: Written from inside it.
items.body: Write them a short letter as if from the middle of your favourite fantasy about the two of you. Send it or read it aloud.

items.title: In Instalments
items.subtitle: One part each day.
items.body: Send them a fantasy in three instalments, one a day, each ending at the best possible moment.

items.title: The Morning After
items.subtitle: Of the fantasy.
items.body: Describe the morning after your wildest fantasy about the two of you: where you wake up, what you say, what you still remember.

items.title: If We Were a Film
items.subtitle: Genre, title, poster.
items.body: If your relationship were a film, what would it be called, what genre is it, and which scene would the trailer end on?

items.title: Make It Real
items.subtitle: One detail at a time.
items.body: Pick one fantasy you both like. Agree, detail by detail, which parts you would actually try and which stay in your heads.

items.title: No Holding Back
items.subtitle: Say all of it.
items.body: Tell them your boldest fantasy about the two of you without holding back a single detail you would want them to know. They may stop you with one word.

items.title: Your Turn to Ask
items.subtitle: Ask for a fantasy.
items.body: Ask them for a fantasy on a theme of your choosing, like 'somewhere dark' or 'a long weekend away'. They tell it their way.

items.title: Somewhere Unexpected
items.subtitle: Private, but unexpected.
items.body: Describe the most unexpected private place you have imagined being alone with them. What makes it irresistible?

items.title: The Perfect Lazy Day
items.subtitle: Hour by hour.
items.body: Describe your fantasy lazy day together, hour by hour, from waking up to the last thing before bed. They add one hour of their own.

items.title: Pick One of Two
items.subtitle: Quick, no thinking.
items.body: Take turns offering two fantasy settings for a night together, a lighthouse or a sleeper train, a cabin or a rooftop. The other picks instantly.

items.title: Postcard From Us
items.subtitle: Five years from now.
items.body: Write a postcard from the two of you five years from now, somewhere wonderful. Read it aloud or send it.

items.title: Where You'd Take Me
items.subtitle: Message a photo from the list.
items.body: Send them a photo of somewhere, anywhere, that you would love to take them one day, and one line about the evening you picture there.

items.title: Who Leads in It
items.subtitle: In your fantasy, who's in charge?
items.body: Describe a fantasy where one of you is in charge for the night. Who is it, and what is the first thing they decide?

items.title: Caught in the Rain
items.subtitle: Where, and then what?
items.body: Describe the perfect version of the two of you getting caught in a storm together: where you are, where you shelter, what happens next.

items.title: Rate the Fantasy
items.subtitle: Mild to unforgettable.
items.body: Describe three fantasies in one line each. They rate each from 'sweet' to 'unforgettable', and explain the top score.

items.title: Pitch a Character
items.subtitle: Who would you be?
items.body: Pitch a character you would love to play for them for one evening: name, backstory, one line of dialogue. They decide if you're cast.

items.title: Script It
items.subtitle: Every line agreed.
items.body: Write the script for a fantasy scene, with every line agreed by both of you before anything happens. Then decide when to perform it.

items.title: A Hint of Yours
items.subtitle: Only a hint.
items.body: Give them one hint about a fantasy you have never mentioned. They may ask three questions; you may answer or kiss them instead.

items.title: Our Secret Life
items.subtitle: In another life.
items.body: Invent the secret double life the two of you would live in another world. Who are you by day, and who are you by night?

items.title: Soundtrack
items.subtitle: For the scene in your head.
items.body: Pick the song that would play during your favourite fantasy about the two of you. Play it. They guess what the scene is.

items.title: One Superpower
items.subtitle: Just for the two of you.
items.body: If the two of you shared one superpower, only when you were together, what would it be and how would you use it tonight?

items.title: The Details Matter
items.subtitle: Sound, light, time.
items.body: Describe a fantasy only through the details around it: the sound, the light, the time on the clock. They fill in the rest.

items.title: The Fantasy List
items.subtitle: Ranked. Real.
items.body: Each write three fantasies on paper, ranked. Compare lists. Anything on both lists goes straight to the top of the shared one.

items.title: The Unsaid One
items.subtitle: The one you've never told anyone.
items.body: Tell them a fantasy you have never told anyone. They answer honestly: yes, maybe, not for me. Every answer is a good answer.

items.title: Time Machine Date
items.subtitle: Any year, any place.
items.body: Pick any year and place in history for a date together. Describe what you would wear and how you would spend the evening.

items.title: Tonight, If We Could
items.subtitle: Within your limits.
items.body: Describe, in full, the fantasy you would choose for tonight if anything within your agreed limits were possible. Then pick one piece of it to make real.

items.title: Fantasy for a Fantasy
items.subtitle: Only if both say yes.
items.body: Trade one fantasy each, told in full. If both of you say yes to both, you have your next two nights planned.

items.title: Tell It Slowly
items.subtitle: Recorded, unhurried.
items.body: Record yourself telling them a fantasy about the two of you, slowly, for no more than three minutes. They listen when they are alone.

items.title: A Scene in Your Voice
items.subtitle: Set it, don't finish it.
items.body: Record a one-minute voice message setting a scene for the two of you: place, time, what they are wearing. Stop before anything happens.

items.title: Weekend Plan
items.subtitle: Unlimited budget.
items.body: Message them a fantasy weekend for two with an unlimited budget. They reply with the one part they would change.

items.title: Just One Night
items.subtitle: Rules suspended.
items.body: If for one night every everyday worry was suspended, what would you most want the two of you to do? Stay within what you would both love.

items.title: Whisper It Instead
items.subtitle: Too much to say out loud.
items.body: Whisper a fantasy you would not say at full volume. They respond only with a look: yes, maybe, or not for me.

items.title: Wildest Date
items.subtitle: Only the two of you.
items.body: Describe the wildest date you can imagine going on together. Two rules: it involves only the two of you, and it stays safe.

items.title: Yes, No, Tell Me More
items.subtitle: Fast answers only.
items.body: Take turns naming a fantasy in five words or fewer. The other answers 'yes', 'no', or 'tell me more'. 'Tell me more' means more.

items.title: The Regular
items.subtitle: Same coffee every day.
items.body: One of you is the barista who has been quietly flirting with the other, a regular, for months. Today one of you finally says something.

items.title: The Secret Romance
items.subtitle: Kept in messages.
items.body: Message each other all day as two people conducting a thrilling secret romance. By evening, the messages have made a plan.

items.title: Stay in Role
items.subtitle: A voice call in character.
items.body: Call each other and stay in role the whole time: two people who met once on holiday and have not stopped thinking about it.

items.title: Draw a Character
items.subtitle: Two folded papers.
items.body: Each write a character on a folded paper, a pirate, a poet, a duchess. Trade papers and play them for ten minutes.

items.title: After the Scene
items.subtitle: Come back to yourselves.
items.body: After any bold roleplay, drop the characters completely. Say what you loved, what you would change, and one thing you want to keep.

items.title: Choose the Scene
items.subtitle: Three settings, one pick.
items.body: Offer three roleplay settings: a train at night, a castle, a heatwave in the city. They choose one and set the first line.

items.title: Dress the Part
items.subtitle: Characters, with outfits.
items.body: Each choose a character and put together a costume from whatever you have at home. Stay in character for the whole evening.

items.title: The Critic
items.subtitle: Every dish, reviewed.
items.body: During your next meal together, one of you is a famous food critic, the other a nervous chef. Stay in role until dessert.

items.title: The Dance Lesson
items.subtitle: Strict teacher. Keen student.
items.body: One of you is a dance instructor, the other a student with a crush. The lesson requires a lot of correcting of posture.

items.title: You Decide Everything
items.subtitle: For one scene.
items.body: For one scene, one of you decides everything, within the limits you agreed: where, what, how slowly. The other says only yes or the safe word.

items.title: The Case of Us
items.subtitle: Two detectives, one mystery.
items.body: Play two detectives investigating a mystery: who took the last biscuit, who chose this film. Interrogate each other with total seriousness.

items.title: You Write Their Lines
items.subtitle: They say them.
items.body: Write three lines for them to say in character. They must deliver each one, exactly as written, at a moment of your choosing.

items.title: Rivals
items.subtitle: You can't stand each other. Allegedly.
items.body: Play two fierce rivals stuck sharing a room for the night. Every argument gets a little closer to not being an argument at all.

items.title: The Fantasy, Live
items.subtitle: The one you both chose.
items.body: Pick a fantasy you both said yes to and play it out as a scene, with names, a setting and an agreed ending. Stop any time either of you wants.

items.title: The Forbidden Meeting
items.subtitle: Nobody can know.
items.body: Play two people meeting in secret on borrowed time. Keep your voices low; the clock is not on your side.

items.title: The Fortune Teller
items.subtitle: Your future, suspiciously specific.
items.body: One of you is a fortune teller reading the other's palm. The predictions must all involve the two of you, and must get cheekier.

items.title: Hear It First
items.subtitle: Then decide together.
items.body: In character, one of you tells the other exactly what is going to happen tonight. The listener may not interrupt, and can stop everything with the safe word.

items.title: The Concierge
items.subtitle: Anything you desire, madam, sir.
items.body: One of you is the concierge of a very exclusive hotel. The other is a demanding guest. Every request must be granted with a flourish.

items.title: Hotel Lobby
items.subtitle: Two people who've never met.
items.body: Meet as two strangers in a hotel lobby. Invent your names and your reasons for being there. One of you makes the first move.

items.title: Letters From 1890
items.subtitle: Forbidden correspondence.
items.body: Write each other letters as secret lovers in 1890 whose families disapprove. Send one a day by message, sealed with something bold.

items.title: The Masquerade
items.subtitle: Masks on. Names off.
items.body: Wear anything that covers your eyes and pretend you are meeting at a masquerade. Flirt without using real names until midnight.

items.title: The Mystery Date
items.subtitle: One plans. One wonders.
items.body: One of you plans the next date without telling the other anything but the time to be ready and what to wear.

items.title: Pen Pals
items.subtitle: Letters from far away.
items.body: Write each other a letter as pen pals who have never met, describing your lives in another country. Send it by message.

items.title: The Shoot
items.subtitle: Hold that pose.
items.body: One of you is a photographer, the other the model. The photographer directs every pose, and keeps finding reasons to adjust things by hand.

items.title: The Scripted Scene
items.subtitle: Agreed in advance, every beat.
items.body: Script a power-dynamic scene together: who leads, what happens, where it stops, and the safe word. Perform it exactly as agreed.

items.title: The Reversal
items.subtitle: Halfway through, switch.
items.body: Start a power-dynamic scene with one of you leading. Halfway through, at a signal, the roles reverse completely.

items.title: Rewrite the First Night
items.subtitle: As different people.
items.body: Replay the first night you spent together as two completely different characters. Keep what worked. Change what you wish you had dared.

items.title: The Royal and the Guard
items.subtitle: Duty versus desire.
items.body: One of you is a royal, the other the bodyguard sworn to keep a respectful distance. Tonight the rules are tested, carefully.

items.title: Royalty for an Evening
items.subtitle: Titles required.
items.body: For the rest of the evening, address each other only by grand, invented royal titles. Every request must be made formally.

items.title: Before You Begin
items.subtitle: Agree the word.
items.body: Before any bold roleplay, agree a safe word, the limits, and one thing each of you is looking forward to. Then begin.

items.title: The Secret Agent
items.subtitle: Mission: seduce the target.
items.body: One of you is a secret agent whose mission is to win the other's trust by any charming means necessary. The target is suspicious.

items.title: The Password
items.subtitle: Spies meet at midnight.
items.body: Agree on a spy password and countersign. Tonight, neither of you gets a kiss until the other says the password correctly, in a whisper.

items.title: The Star and the Fan
items.subtitle: An exclusive interview.
items.body: One of you is a famous star, the other a devoted fan who has won a private meeting. The star is more nervous than expected.

items.title: Unknown Number
items.subtitle: Bolder with every message.
items.body: Message each other as two strangers who met briefly and can't stop thinking about it. Each message a little bolder than the one before.

items.title: Strangers All Night
items.subtitle: Never break it.
items.body: Meet as strangers and never break character, not once, until the next morning. Either of you can step out with the safe word.

items.title: Strangers for a Night
items.subtitle: Arrive separately.
items.body: Arrive somewhere separately, a restaurant or a lobby, and meet as strangers. Stay strangers all the way home, and past the door.

items.title: The Late Show
items.subtitle: They are the guest.
items.body: One of you hosts a late-night talk show, the other is tonight's famous guest. Ask about their scandalous rise to fame.

items.title: The Artist's Model
items.subtitle: Sit very still.
items.body: One of you is an artist sketching the other, who must sit perfectly still while being studied very closely. The artist takes their time.

items.title: The Boss for an Evening
items.subtitle: Everything is an order.
items.body: One of you plays the boss for the evening, the other the assistant eager to impress. Within your agreed limits, every request is followed.

items.title: The Interview
items.subtitle: For the position of your date.
items.body: Interview them for the position of your date tonight. Ask about relevant experience, strengths, and how they handle pressure.

items.title: The New Neighbour
items.subtitle: Borrowing something. Again.
items.body: One of you has just moved in next door and keeps finding reasons to knock. The other starts leaving the door open.

items.title: The Proposition
items.subtitle: Business, allegedly.
items.body: One of you arrives with a very serious business proposition. The other keeps steering the meeting somewhere far less professional.

items.title: Time Travellers
items.subtitle: Just arrived. Very confused.
items.body: You have both just arrived from different centuries and are meeting for the first time. Explain modern life to each other, badly.

items.title: The Tour
items.subtitle: Your home, very grand.
items.body: Give them a guided tour of your own home as if it were a stately mansion open for one night only. Charge a kiss for entry.

items.title: In a World...
items.subtitle: Narrate your night.
items.body: Narrate your evening together in the voice of a dramatic film trailer. The other acts out every scene you announce.

items.title: Their Character, Your Voice
items.subtitle: Recorded in role.
items.body: Record a voice message in character: the stranger who cannot forget them, telling them what happens when you finally meet again.

items.title: Wrong Number
items.subtitle: Texting someone you've never met.
items.body: Send a message as if you have texted the wrong number by accident. Keep the conversation going as two people who should not be flirting, but are.

items.title: Afterwards
items.subtitle: Come back gently.
items.body: After any night where one of you was in charge, spend ten minutes close together. Say what felt good, and one thing to change.

items.title: Ask Nicely
items.subtitle: Every request, properly.
items.body: For the rest of the night, one of you must ask for everything properly, in a full sentence, and wait for permission.

items.title: Blindfolded Trust
items.subtitle: They lead. You feel.
items.body: Blindfolded, you let them lead you through ten slow minutes of touch they choose, within the limits you agreed. Say the safe word any time.

items.title: Green, Yellow, Red
items.subtitle: Say it any time.
items.body: Before a bold night, agree to use green, yellow and red as check-ins. Use them at least once, just to know they work.

items.title: Your Pick, Their Evening
items.subtitle: Menu of three.
items.body: Offer them a menu of three ways the next half hour could go. They choose one. From then on, you lead.

items.title: Commands Only
items.subtitle: Short. Clear. Kind.
items.body: For twenty minutes, the one in charge speaks only in short, clear commands. The other answers only 'yes' or the safe word.

items.title: In Your Pocket
items.subtitle: Their messages, your evening.
items.body: For one evening apart, every choice you make waits for their message first. They decide, you report back, they decide again.

items.title: The Decider
items.subtitle: One of you chooses everything.
items.body: For the rest of the evening, one of you makes every small decision: what to eat, what to watch, where to sit. The other simply enjoys it.

items.title: Dress Me
items.subtitle: Tonight's outfit is theirs to choose.
items.body: They choose what you wear for the evening, down to the last detail. You wear it with total confidence.

items.title: Hand Over the Night
items.subtitle: Within the limits, all of it.
items.body: Hand over the whole night. Within the limits you agreed and with your safe word ready, they decide everything that happens.

items.title: Hand Signals
items.subtitle: No words, only gestures.
items.body: For ten minutes, they direct you using only hand signals: come here, sit, closer, stop. You work out each one.

items.title: Hands Behind Your Back
items.subtitle: Unless told otherwise.
items.body: For ten minutes, one of you keeps their hands behind their back unless the other says otherwise. Enjoy not being in charge, for once.

items.title: Hold Still
items.subtitle: However tempting.
items.body: They hold perfectly still while you take your time. Every movement they make resets your count to zero.

items.title: Host for the Night
items.subtitle: Everything arranged by you.
items.body: Host them at home tonight as if they were your most important guest. You plan it, you set it up, they only arrive.

items.title: In Charge Tonight
items.subtitle: Every decision, theirs.
items.body: One of you is in charge of the whole night, within the limits you both set. The other agrees to every reasonable request, gracefully.

items.title: Instructions by Message
items.subtitle: Follow them, one at a time.
items.body: Send them five instructions by message over the evening, one at a time, each only after they confirm the last is done.

items.title: Follow My Lead
items.subtitle: One song.
items.body: Dance to one song where one of you leads completely. The follower does not anticipate, only responds.

items.title: Lead the Way
items.subtitle: Eyes on them.
items.body: Take them on a short walk where they do not know the route. They hold your hand and trust every turn.

items.title: The Negotiation
items.subtitle: Before anything bold.
items.body: Sit down and agree what a night with one of you in charge would look like: what is welcome, what is off limits, and your safe word.

items.title: The Agreed List
items.subtitle: Written before, kept after.
items.body: Write a list together of things the one in charge may ask for tonight, and things that are off limits. Follow the list, nothing beyond it.

items.title: Permission Required
items.subtitle: Ask first. Every time.
items.body: For the next fifteen minutes, they must ask your permission before every kiss, and you may say 'not yet' as often as you like.

items.title: Order for Me
items.subtitle: At the next meal.
items.body: At your next meal together, they choose everything for you without asking what you want. Enjoy whatever arrives.

items.title: DJ Rules
items.subtitle: The DJ decides.
items.body: Whoever is DJ tonight picks every song, and the other may not skip a single one. Trade roles tomorrow.

items.title: Leader or Follower?
items.subtitle: Predict their answers.
items.body: Predict whether they would rather lead or follow in five situations you invent, from dancing to planning a holiday. Check your answers.

items.title: Their Remote Evening
items.subtitle: They choose from afar.
items.body: Over a video call, they choose what you do for twenty minutes: where you sit, what you say, when you may stop smiling.

items.title: Choose My Evening
items.subtitle: From wherever you are.
items.body: From a distance, they choose how you spend the next half hour: what you eat, what you watch, what you wear. Send photos as proof.

items.title: House Rules
items.subtitle: Set from afar.
items.body: Set three playful rules for them to keep until you next speak: something to wear, something to say, something to think about.

items.title: Earned It
items.subtitle: Everything must be earned.
items.body: Tonight, every kiss must be earned. The one in charge sets the tasks; the other decides how hard they want to try.

items.title: Rules of the Night
items.subtitle: Written, agreed, kept.
items.body: The one in charge writes three rules for the night; the other reads and agrees to them, or amends one. Then the rules stand.

items.title: Their Voice, Your Night
items.subtitle: Over a call, all evening.
items.body: On a call, they guide your whole evening alone: what to put on, where to be, what to imagine. Stop the moment either of you says so.

items.title: The Sealed Rule
items.subtitle: Opened at a moment they choose.
items.body: Write one rule for them in a sealed note. They must open it the moment you give the signal, and keep it for the rest of the night.

items.title: Couple Says
items.subtitle: Only when they say it.
items.body: Play 'Couple Says' for five minutes: do only what they ask when they start with 'Couple says'. Every slip-up costs a kiss.

items.title: Stay There
items.subtitle: Don't move until I say.
items.body: Ask them to stay exactly where they are while you move around them, deciding when to come closer. They wait for your word.

items.title: Switch
items.subtitle: Mid-kiss, the lead changes.
items.body: Kiss with one of you completely leading. When they squeeze your hand, you take over. Keep switching until neither of you remembers who started.

items.title: Switch Night
items.subtitle: Half each.
items.body: Split the night in two. One of you leads the first half completely; at midnight, everything reverses. Compare notes in the morning.

items.title: Tell Me To
items.subtitle: They choose the words.
items.body: Ask them to tell you exactly what they want you to do next. Do it, precisely as said, and nothing more until they say so.

items.title: A Voice to Follow
items.subtitle: Their voice, nothing else.
items.body: One of you closes their eyes and follows only the other's voice for ten minutes: where to move, how slowly, when to stop.

items.title: The Request Jar
items.subtitle: Draw one, grant it.
items.body: Each write five small requests and fold them into a jar. Take turns drawing one and granting it, no questions asked.

items.title: All Week
items.subtitle: Small rules, every day.
items.body: For one week, they set you one small, playful rule each morning by message. Keep every one, and report back each night.

items.title: Three Yeses
items.subtitle: Say yes to the next three.
items.body: Say yes to the next three things they ask of you, each within your limits. They must use their three wisely.

items.title: Trade the Lead
items.subtitle: Every five minutes.
items.body: For half an hour, whoever is leading switches every five minutes. Notice which half you enjoy more, and say so.

items.title: The Waiting Game
items.subtitle: They decide when.
items.body: Nothing happens until they decide it does. You may ask once. After that, you wait, however long they make you.

items.title: Who Leads?
items.subtitle: An honest chat.
items.body: Talk about when each of you likes to lead and when you like to be led, in everyday life and otherwise. No wrong answers.

items.title: Yes, Chef
items.subtitle: The kitchen belongs to them.
items.body: Cook something together where one of you is head chef and the other replies to every request with 'yes, chef'. Enjoy the meal.

items.title: You Pick, I Follow
items.subtitle: Three choices in a row.
items.body: Hand them three decisions in a row, the film, the snack, the blanket. Accept every answer without a single complaint.

items.title: The Blindfolded Evening
items.subtitle: Only what you agreed.
items.body: One of you stays blindfolded for the whole of the next half hour. Everything they experience is a choice the other made, inside your agreed limits.

items.title: Blindfolded Tasting
items.subtitle: Five bites.
items.body: Blindfold them and feed them five small tastes, sweet, sour, something surprising. Make each one arrive a little more slowly.

items.title: Blindfold and Trust
items.subtitle: They choose what comes next.
items.body: Blindfold one of you. For ten minutes the other decides every sensation: a touch, a whisper, a pause, a kiss. Nothing unannounced beyond what you agreed.

items.title: Breathe Together
items.subtitle: In, and out.
items.body: Lie close and match your breathing to theirs for three minutes. Then let yours slow down and see if they follow.

items.title: Candlelight Only
items.subtitle: Everything else off.
items.body: Switch off every light and every screen. Spend the next half hour by candlelight only, talking about anything.

items.title: Describe Your Touch
items.subtitle: By message.
items.body: Message them the way you would touch them if you were together now, slowly, one message per minute. Stop at five.

items.title: They Direct the Senses
items.subtitle: Blindfold on, voice only.
items.body: Blindfolded, one of you gives the other whispered instructions for exactly how to touch them, slowly, within your limits.

items.title: Every Sense
items.subtitle: All five, one night.
items.body: Plan one night that touches every sense: a scent on the pillow, a song you chose, a taste, a texture, and the light just right. Then enjoy it.

items.title: Eyes Closed
items.subtitle: All the other senses.
items.body: Both of you close your eyes for five minutes. Kiss, touch and listen without looking once. Talk about what felt different.

items.title: Guess the Texture
items.subtitle: Eyes closed.
items.body: Collect four things with different textures: silk, wool, a feather, something cool. With their eyes closed, trace each along their arm. They guess.

items.title: Lightest Touch
items.subtitle: Barely there.
items.body: With the lightest touch you can manage, trace slow lines along their arms, neck and back. Stop whenever they start to lean in.

items.title: The Full Massage
items.subtitle: Everything slowed right down.
items.body: Give them a slow, unhurried full-body massage with warm oil, low light and quiet music. Ask what they want more of, and give it.

items.title: Hands First
items.subtitle: Every finger.
items.body: Give each of their hands a slow massage, every finger, every knuckle. Say nothing. Let them notice how long you take.

items.title: Warm Hands
items.subtitle: Hold them, that's all.
items.body: Hold their hands in yours for two full minutes without talking. Notice every small thing: temperature, pressure, pulse.

items.title: Heartbeat
items.subtitle: Listen closely.
items.body: Rest your head on their chest and listen to their heartbeat until it changes. Tell them what you think changed it.

items.title: Ice and Warmth
items.subtitle: Slowly, with care.
items.body: With their agreement, trace a piece of ice slowly along their arm or back, then follow it with your warm hand. Stop at their first 'enough'.

items.title: Change the Light
items.subtitle: Every colour, a mood.
items.body: Dim the lights to three different levels over the evening. At each one, tell them what that light makes you want to do.

items.title: Nowhere to Be
items.subtitle: An hour. Just this.
items.body: Give them a whole hour of massage with nowhere else to be. They decide at the end how the hour should finish.

items.title: The Long Massage
items.subtitle: Twenty minutes. No rushing.
items.body: Give them a twenty-minute massage with warm oil and low music. No rushing, and no talking except to ask what feels good.

items.title: Our Song
items.subtitle: Find it together.
items.body: Play each other five songs each until you find one that should be yours. It must make you both look at each other at the same moment.

items.title: Everything at Once
items.subtitle: Then nothing at all.
items.body: Music loud, lights low, a scent in the air, hands everywhere agreed. Then, at a signal, stop everything and stay perfectly still together.

items.title: The Trail
items.subtitle: Follow your nose.
items.body: Put a little of your scent in three places around your home. Give them one clue. They follow the trail to find you.

items.title: A Playlist for Tonight
items.subtitle: Made for their ears.
items.body: Make them a playlist for tonight, whether you are together or apart, that starts sweet and slowly turns into something else.

items.title: Blind Scent
items.subtitle: Which one is you?
items.body: Blindfolded, they smell three things, one of them your skin. They choose. Whatever they choose, they may kiss.

items.title: Scent Memory
items.subtitle: Which scent is them?
items.body: Tell them which scent always reminds you of them, and the moment it first did. If you can find it, let them smell it now.

items.title: Where Is It?
items.subtitle: Find the scent.
items.body: Put the smallest trace of a scent somewhere on your skin. They have to find exactly where, using only their nose.

items.title: The Scented Letter
items.subtitle: Something they'll recognise.
items.body: Send them a handwritten note with a trace of your scent on it. Ask them what they thought of first when they opened it.

items.title: One Sense at a Time
items.subtitle: Sight, sound, touch.
items.body: Spend five minutes on each sense in turn: only looking, only whispering, only touching. Save the last sense for last.

items.title: Set the Room
items.subtitle: Light, sound, scent.
items.body: Take five minutes to change the room for the two of you: the lighting, the music, one scent. Then sit back and notice what changed.

items.title: Five-Minute Massage
items.subtitle: Shoulders only.
items.body: Give them a slow five-minute massage, shoulders and neck only. Ask twice what feels good and do more of it.

items.title: Silk and Patience
items.subtitle: No hurrying allowed.
items.body: Trace silk over their skin for ten slow minutes, anywhere they have agreed, and nowhere they have not. They may not touch you back.

items.title: The Slow Half Hour
items.subtitle: Everything at half speed.
items.body: For half an hour, do everything together at half speed: eating, talking, walking, touching. Notice what you usually rush past.

items.title: Slower
items.subtitle: Everything takes twice as long.
items.body: Whatever you do next, take twice as long as feels natural. Every time they try to hurry, whisper 'slower'.

items.title: What I Can Hear
items.subtitle: Describe it to them.
items.body: Close your eyes wherever you are and describe to them every sound you can hear, then how it would change if they were next to you.

items.title: Same Room, Far Apart
items.subtitle: Build it together.
items.body: Apart, build the same scene at the same time: dim light, the same song, a candle each. Then describe to each other, by voice, what you would do next.

items.title: Same Song, Same Time
items.subtitle: Wherever you are.
items.body: Agree on a song and press play at exactly the same moment, wherever you both are. Message each other one word when it ends.

items.title: Taste Test
items.subtitle: Eyes closed. Guess it.
items.body: Take turns feeding each other small bites with your eyes closed. Guess each one. Every right answer earns a kiss.

items.title: Hot and Cold
items.subtitle: Agreed first. Slow always.
items.body: Agree where and how, then alternate ice and a warm cup against their skin, slowly, pausing for their word each time.

items.title: The Texture Trail
items.subtitle: Silk, then something else.
items.body: Blindfolded, they feel a trail of textures along their skin: silk, a feather, your fingertips, your breath. They may say 'again' to any of them.

items.title: Every Track, a Kiss
items.subtitle: Ten songs.
items.body: Play ten songs. On every new track, the person whose turn it is chooses where the next kiss goes.

items.title: The Slowest Kiss
items.subtitle: Five minutes long.
items.body: Make one kiss last five full minutes, as slowly as either of you can stand. Nothing else happens until it ends.

items.title: Show Me Your Room
items.subtitle: Candlelit call.
items.body: On a video call, both of you light a candle and turn every other light off. Talk for twenty minutes by candlelight, as close to the screen as you like.

items.title: Your Voice, Low
items.subtitle: Headphones on.
items.body: Record a voice message describing the room you wish you were in with them right now: the light, the sounds, the warmth. Ask them to listen with headphones.

items.title: Close Your Eyes and Listen
items.subtitle: Recorded for later.
items.body: Record a voice message describing, in slow detail, a sensory evening together: the light, the warmth, where your hands go first.

items.title: Voice in the Dark
items.subtitle: A call with the lights out.
items.body: Call each other with every light off. Describe, slowly, exactly what you would do if the other were within reach.

items.title: Warm, Then Cool
items.subtitle: The contrast.
items.body: Warm your hands on a cup of tea, then cool them on a glass of water. Let them feel the difference against their skin, back and forth.

items.title: The Ambush
items.subtitle: When they least expect it.
items.body: Sometime tomorrow, at the least expected moment, pull them in for the kind of kiss usually saved for the end of a night.

items.title: A Package for Tonight
items.subtitle: Opened on a call.
items.body: Post them a small package to open on a video call with you: something to wear, something to hold, and a note for afterwards.

items.title: Arrival, Blindfolded
items.subtitle: The reveal is the room.
items.body: Blindfold them at the door and lead them into a room you have prepared. Take the blindfold off only when everything is exactly right.

items.title: The Midnight Surprise
items.subtitle: Scheduled for twelve.
items.body: Schedule the boldest message you have ever sent them to arrive at exactly midnight. Do not mention it beforehand.

items.title: Tonight, Decided
items.subtitle: They find out on arrival.
items.body: Plan the rest of tonight entirely on your own, inside the limits you both know. They find out what each part is only as it begins.

items.title: Breakfast Ambush
items.subtitle: Before they're awake.
items.body: Make tomorrow's breakfast a surprise: their favourite thing, a note on the plate, and one line about what you love about their mornings.

items.title: A Surprise, by Message
items.subtitle: Delivered at a random time.
items.body: At a random moment today, send them one bold message they could never have predicted. Nothing before it, nothing after.

items.title: Two Envelopes
items.subtitle: One sweet, one bold.
items.body: Offer two envelopes: one sweet, one bold. They choose without opening either. Open both at the end of the night, together.

items.title: Choose a Door
items.subtitle: Three envelopes.
items.body: Offer three sealed envelopes, each describing a different evening. They choose one without knowing what the other two held. You never tell them.

items.title: Three Days Out
items.subtitle: A countdown with no hint.
items.body: Send them a countdown, three days to something, with no clue what it is. Make whatever arrives on day three worth the wait.

items.title: The Bold Jar
items.subtitle: One a night.
items.body: Fill a jar with bold dares for each other, inside your limits. Draw one at a random moment tonight and do it immediately.

items.title: Stolen Away
items.subtitle: Everything is arranged.
items.body: Tell them you are stealing them away for an evening soon and that everything will be arranged. Tonight, they only have to pick the date and say yes.

items.title: Something at the Door
items.subtitle: Sent from afar.
items.body: Have something small delivered to them without warning: their favourite snack, a flower, a book. Include a note with no signature.

items.title: The Dress Code
items.subtitle: Given, not explained.
items.body: Send them a dress code for this evening with no explanation. Arrive dressed to match it, and make the evening live up to it.

items.title: The Sealed Evening
items.subtitle: Opened on arrival.
items.body: Hand them a sealed envelope describing tonight in detail. They open it only when you both walk through the door.

items.title: Unexpected Song
items.subtitle: Playing as they walk in.
items.body: Have a song that means something to both of you playing, not too loud, the next time they walk through the door.

items.title: The Note in Their Bag
items.subtitle: They'll find it at work.
items.body: Tuck a note into their bag that they will find in the middle of an ordinary day. One line. Bold enough to make them blush.

items.title: Hidden Notes
items.subtitle: Five of them.
items.body: Hide five small notes where they will find them over the next week: a coat pocket, a book, the fridge. Each one a different reason.

items.title: Checked In
items.subtitle: Somewhere new, tonight.
items.body: Book somewhere for one night soon, even nearby. Tonight, hand them a note with only the date on it. Everything else stays a surprise.

items.title: The Surprise Instruction
items.subtitle: Arrives mid-evening.
items.body: Partway through the evening, hand them a sealed note with one bold instruction. They follow it, or say pass, no explanation needed.

items.title: Remember This?
items.subtitle: A photo from before.
items.body: Send them a photo from early in your relationship they have forgotten you took, with one line about what you were thinking that day.

items.title: Breakfast Encore
items.subtitle: Surprise continues.
items.body: After a bold night, surprise them again the next morning: breakfast, a note about your favourite moment, and one plan for next time.

items.title: Something New
items.subtitle: Neither of you has tried it.
items.body: Surprise them with something neither of you has tried before, planned inside the limits you both know. Ask once more before you begin.

items.title: The One-Minute Call
items.subtitle: Then hang up.
items.body: Call them at an unexpected moment today and, in under a minute, tell them one bold thing you have planned for the next time you are alone. Then hang up.

items.title: What's Underneath
items.subtitle: They'll find out later.
items.body: Tell them in the morning that you are wearing something for them under your clothes today. Refuse every question until tonight.

items.title: An Unexpected Photo
items.subtitle: Tasteful. Timed perfectly.
items.body: Send a photo they are not expecting, tasteful and a little daring, at a moment when they can only look at it once.

items.title: Mystery Evening
items.subtitle: Wear something nice.
items.body: Plan a mystery evening for next week that you know they'll love. Tonight, tell them only the time and what to wear, and nothing else.

items.title: The Room Is Different
items.subtitle: When they walk in.
items.body: Change the bedroom before they come home: new light, fresh sheets, one scent, one song ready. Say nothing. Let them notice.

items.title: Surprise Me Back
