items.subtitle: Twenty-four hours.
items.body: Tell them you have planned a small surprise for them, and that they have twenty-four hours to plan one for you. Compare at the end.

items.title: Someone New at the Door
items.subtitle: They answer, you're in role.
items.body: Knock on your own front door in character, as someone they have never met. Stay in role for as long as they want to play.

items.title: A Scene They Walk Into
items.subtitle: Set before they arrive.
items.body: Set a scene for them to walk into: the lighting, the music, you already there waiting. Say nothing until they close the door.

items.title: Tonight's Plan, Partly
items.subtitle: Half of it.
items.body: Tell them half of tonight's plan. The other half stays hidden until it is happening.

items.title: The Upgrade
items.subtitle: An ordinary evening, improved.
items.body: Take an ordinary evening you already planned and quietly upgrade one part of it: a better dessert, a view, a song. Watch them notice.

items.title: The Mystery Box
items.subtitle: Opened only together.
items.body: Put three small things in a box, each connected to something you want to do together. They open it with you, one item at a time.

items.title: Midday
items.subtitle: Bold, then gone.
items.body: Call them in the middle of their day, say one bold sentence about tonight, and hang up before they can answer.

items.title: A Tiny Gift
items.subtitle: Under five minutes to find.
items.body: Pick up the smallest gift that would still make them smile, something that only makes sense to the two of you. Hand it over without explanation.

items.title: The Voice Message
items.subtitle: Timed for when they're alone.
items.body: Send a voice message timed for when you know they will be alone, telling them exactly what you want next time. Keep it under two minutes.

items.title: Out of Nowhere
items.subtitle: A voice message they don't expect.
items.body: In the middle of their day, send a thirty-second voice message saying one thing you love about them and one thing you are looking forward to tonight.

items.title: First Thing
items.subtitle: Before their alarm.
items.body: Schedule a message to arrive just before their alarm tomorrow: something so good it becomes the best part of their morning.

items.title: The Whole Night, Planned
items.subtitle: Every step a surprise.
items.body: Plan your next bold night from start to finish, within the limits you agreed, and tell them nothing. Tonight, give them a sealed envelope with only the first step inside.

items.title: Wildcard
items.subtitle: Roll for it.
items.body: Write six ideas for tonight, from sweet to bold, and number them. Roll a die. Whatever comes up, you do.

items.title: Best Moment
items.subtitle: After the games.
items.body: After a night of games and dares, lie close and take turns naming the best moment, the funniest, and one to repeat.

items.title: Guess by Touch
items.subtitle: Blindfolded, three guesses.
items.body: Blindfolded, they guess which part of your hand, arm or face is touching theirs. Every right answer, they get a kiss.

items.title: The Wild Jar
items.subtitle: Your boldest ideas.
items.body: Each write your five boldest ideas inside your limits and mix them in a jar. Draw three. The night is those three.

items.title: Build It Together
items.subtitle: No talking allowed.
items.body: Build something together, a tower of cards, a blanket fort, a meal, without speaking a single word. Only gestures and looks.

items.title: Compliment Battle
items.subtitle: Last one standing.
items.body: Trade compliments back and forth without repeating yourself or pausing more than five seconds. The first to stall has to kiss the winner.

items.title: Ten Minutes, Ten Challenges
items.subtitle: One a minute.
items.body: Write ten small bold challenges on slips of paper. Draw one every minute for ten minutes and complete it before the next.

items.title: Dance-Off
items.subtitle: One song each.
items.body: Each choose one song and perform your most convincing dance for the other. The winner is whoever makes the other laugh or blush first.

items.title: The Dare Ladder
items.subtitle: Each rung a little higher.
items.body: Take turns daring each other, each dare a little bolder than the last. Either of you can stop the climb at any rung.

items.title: Dice Night
items.subtitle: Two dice decide.
items.body: Make two lists of six: one of actions, one of places, all within your limits. Roll one die for each. Do what they say.

items.title: Portrait in Sixty Seconds
items.subtitle: Eyes on them, not the paper.
items.body: Draw each other in sixty seconds without looking at the paper. Trade drawings and give each portrait a title.

items.title: Forfeit Night
items.subtitle: Every loss, a forfeit.
items.body: Play three quick games. Every loss earns a forfeit from the other's list, each bolder than the one before, inside your limits.

items.title: The Forfeit List
items.subtitle: Lose a round, spin the list.
items.body: Play any quick game together. Every time someone loses, the winner picks a forfeit from a list you wrote together beforehand.

items.title: Guess the Memory
items.subtitle: Three clues.
items.body: Describe one moment from your relationship in three clues. They guess it. Every correct guess, they choose the next clue-giver's forfeit.

items.title: No Hands, Five Minutes
items.subtitle: Everything else allowed.
items.body: For five minutes, neither of you may use your hands. Everything else within your limits is allowed. First to use their hands loses.

items.title: Warmer, Colder
items.subtitle: Find the hidden note.
items.body: Hide a note that says what they win. Guide them to it with only 'warmer' and 'colder'. Deliver the prize immediately.

items.title: How Well Do You Know Me?
items.subtitle: Five questions.
items.body: Ask five questions about yourself: your first concert, your comfort food, your secret talent. Score them out of five. Then switch.

items.title: Kiss or Answer
items.subtitle: Your choice, every time.
items.body: Ask each other personal questions. For each one, the other may answer honestly or pay with a kiss instead.

items.title: Beat the Timer
items.subtitle: Thirty seconds.
items.body: Set a timer for thirty seconds. Kiss them until it goes off, then stop completely for thirty seconds. Repeat three times.

items.title: The Kissing Marathon
items.subtitle: Keep going.
items.body: Kiss for as long as you both want, with only one rule: whoever pulls away first chooses what happens next.

items.title: Our Boldest Memory
items.subtitle: Tell it together.
items.body: Tell the story of the boldest thing you have done together, alternating lines. Then plan something bolder.

items.title: Memory Race
items.subtitle: Who remembers more?
items.body: Pick one date from your past together. Take turns naming details about it. The first to run out owes the other a favour.

items.title: Our Story in Ten Words
items.subtitle: Exactly ten.
items.body: Each tell the story of your relationship in exactly ten words. Compare. Combine the best of both into one line to keep.

items.title: Photo Hunt
items.subtitle: Five things that remind you of us.
items.body: Each find and photograph five things around you that remind you of the two of you. Share them and explain each one.

items.title: Predict Their Pick
items.subtitle: Before they choose.
items.body: Before they choose anything to eat tonight, write down what you think they will pick. Reveal it after. Loser does the dishes.

items.title: Know My Limits
items.subtitle: Honestly, gently.
items.body: Predict where their limits are on five bold ideas: yes, maybe, or not for me. Compare. Talk about anything that surprised you.

items.title: Predict Their Answer
items.subtitle: Then they answer honestly.
items.body: Ask a flirty question: where they would most like to be kissed, their favourite thing you wear. Predict their answer, then hear it.

items.title: What Would They Choose?
items.subtitle: About tonight.
items.body: Predict what they would choose for tonight from three bold options you invent. Ask them. If you are right, you choose next.

items.title: How Well Do You Know Their Wants
items.subtitle: No guessing twice.
items.body: Predict, in writing, the three things they most want tonight. Read them aloud. They confirm, correct, or add one.

items.title: The Distance Game
items.subtitle: Points for boldness.
items.body: Over a video call, take turns doing bold little dares for each other. The other awards points out of ten. Winner chooses the next call's theme.

items.title: Tonight's Challenge
items.subtitle: Set by message.
items.body: Set each other one bold challenge to complete before bed tonight, then report back by message. Photo proof optional.

items.title: Dare by Message
items.subtitle: Small, sweet, done now.
items.body: Send each other one small dare by message, sweet enough to say yes to, and send photo proof when it's done.

items.title: The Distance Quiz
items.subtitle: Rapid fire by message.
items.body: Send them ten rapid-fire questions about you by message. They have thirty seconds per answer. Keep score and set a forfeit.

items.title: The Boldest Dare
items.subtitle: Over a call, tonight.
items.body: On a video call tonight, each of you gives the other the boldest dare you dare to give, inside your limits. Both are completed live.

items.title: Same Answer
items.subtitle: Say it at the same time.
items.body: Count to three and say your answer to a question at the same time: best holiday, worst film, dream city. Every match earns a point.

items.title: The Hunt
items.subtitle: Clues all over the house.
items.body: Hide five clues around your home, each hinting at the next. The last one leads to you and a promise for the rest of the evening.

items.title: Lyrics Only
items.subtitle: Flirt in song lines.
items.body: Flirt with each other using only song lyrics for five minutes. Every lyric they recognise earns you a point.

items.title: Staring Contest
items.subtitle: First to laugh loses.
items.body: Hold a staring contest. The loser owes the winner a compliment, delivered with total sincerity and a straight face.

items.title: Keep a Straight Face
items.subtitle: They try everything.
items.body: For two minutes you must keep a completely straight face while they try every flirty trick they know to make you crack.

items.title: Twenty Questions, Bolder
items.subtitle: Yes or no only.
items.body: Think of something you want to do tonight. They have twenty yes-or-no questions to guess it. If they get it, it happens.

items.title: Loser Leads
items.subtitle: The twist.
items.body: Play any game. Then reverse the usual rule: the loser leads for the rest of the night, inside your limits.

items.title: The Bet
items.subtitle: Winner chooses the night.
items.body: Make a bet on anything, a game, a film ending, a race. The winner decides how the rest of the night goes.

items.title: Who Gives In First
items.subtitle: Close, and closer.
items.body: Get as close as you can without kissing. Whoever gives in first owes the other a bold favour, chosen inside your limits.

items.title: Challenge Accepted
items.subtitle: Lead or be led.
items.body: Play any quick game. The winner leads for the next ten minutes, the loser follows, inside your agreed limits.

items.title: The Long Game
items.subtitle: All week.
items.body: For one week, set each other one bold challenge a day, building towards a night you plan together at the end of it.

items.title: Sixty Seconds of You
items.subtitle: As many as possible.
items.body: Set a timer for sixty seconds. List as many things you find attractive about them as you can. Beat their score.

items.title: Truth or Dare, Bold
items.subtitle: Bolder rules.
items.body: Play truth or dare with bold truths and bolder dares, inside the limits you both set. Each of you gets one pass, no reason needed.

items.title: Truth or Dare
items.subtitle: Within your limits.
items.body: Play truth or dare for fifteen minutes. Truths must be honest, dares must be bold and kind. Either of you can pass once.

items.title: Truth or Dare, No Holding Back
items.subtitle: Inside your limits, all the way.
items.body: Play truth or dare with nothing held back inside your agreed limits. Check in with a word halfway through. Keep going only if both say yes.

items.title: Two Truths and a Lie
items.subtitle: About what you want.
items.body: Tell them two true things and one lie about what you would like to do together. They have to find the lie.

items.title: Who Leans In First
items.subtitle: The closeness game.
items.body: Sit face to face, close enough to kiss. Whoever leans in first loses and must grant the other one wish, inside your limits.

items.title: Winner Takes All
items.subtitle: One game. Everything on it.
items.body: Play one game with everything on the line: the winner decides everything about the rest of the night, within your limits.

items.title: Bedtime Story
items.subtitle: Read them to sleep.
items.body: Call them at bedtime and read them a few pages of a book you love until they tell you goodnight.

items.title: After Dark Call
items.subtitle: Say what you can't type.
items.body: Call late at night with the lights off. Tell each other the things you would never put in writing, as slowly as you like.

items.title: The Candlelit Call
items.subtitle: Lights out, voices low.
items.body: Call each other with the lights off and a single candle lit. Talk only in low voices for twenty minutes about what you want next time.

items.title: Dinner for Two, Apart
items.subtitle: Same recipe, two kitchens.
items.body: Cook the same simple recipe at the same time on a video call. Eat together, table to table, and toast with whatever is in your glass.

items.title: The Countdown Ritual
items.subtitle: Every night until you meet.
items.body: Every night until you see each other, send the number of days left and one thing you will do together when the countdown hits zero.

items.title: Your Day in Five Photos
items.subtitle: No captions until the end.
items.body: Send them five photos from your day, no captions. At the end of the day, they guess the story, and you tell them the real one.

items.title: Dress Rehearsal
items.subtitle: Every moment you'll repeat.
items.body: On a video call, rehearse your next night together like a play: the entrance, the first line, the first kiss. Mark every moment you will repeat for real.

items.title: The Next Visit
items.subtitle: Plan it boldly.
items.body: Plan your next visit in bold detail over a call: what you will wear, where you will go, and what happens when the door closes.

items.title: Say It Out Loud
items.subtitle: Not in writing.
items.body: Record a voice message saying the flirtiest thing you would say if they were next to you right now. Keep it under thirty seconds.

items.title: Guess Where I Am
items.subtitle: Three clues.
items.body: Send three photo clues of where you are right now. They have three guesses. A right guess earns a promise for next time.

items.title: Notes Left Behind
items.subtitle: For the days apart.
items.body: Hide five small notes in their bag, coat pockets and books tonight, one line each. They will find them over the next days you spend apart.

items.title: If I Were There
items.subtitle: A list to work through.
items.body: Write the next ten minutes as a list of things you would work through if you were there, and send it. They mark the ones they want first.

items.title: The Midnight Collection
items.subtitle: Unedited.
items.body: For one day, record a short voice note every time you think about them boldly. Send the whole collection at midnight, unedited.

items.title: Mirror Me
items.subtitle: On camera, move together.
items.body: On a video call, one of you makes slow movements, the other mirrors them exactly. Switch after three minutes.

items.title: What I Miss
items.subtitle: Specific, not generic.
items.body: Message them the five most specific things you miss about them. Not 'your smile': the way it looks when they are trying not to laugh.

items.title: Good Morning, Voice
items.subtitle: First thing they hear.
items.body: Record a short good-morning voice message for them to wake up to. Tell them one thing you are looking forward to today.

items.title: Open When It's a Bad Day
items.subtitle: Sealed for later.
items.body: Send them a letter to open only on a bad day: what you love about them, a memory that makes you laugh, and a promise.

items.title: Open When You Miss Me
items.subtitle: A letter for later.
items.body: Write them a letter to open the next time they miss you. Tell them what you would do if you could be there at that exact moment.

items.title: Outfit Check
items.subtitle: Before you go out.
items.body: Before either of you goes anywhere tonight, send an outfit photo for their approval. They rate it and add one flirty note.

items.title: The Photo You'd Never Send
items.subtitle: Send it anyway, tastefully.
items.body: Send them the most daring photo you are comfortable with, tasteful and entirely your choice. They reply with a voice note.

items.title: A Hint of You
items.subtitle: Suggestive, not explicit.
items.body: Send a photo that hints at what you are wearing, or not wearing, tonight. Suggestion only. They reply with one word.

items.title: Something of Yours
items.subtitle: They can hold on to.
items.body: Send them something that smells like you, a scarf, a t-shirt, a note with your scent, to keep near them until you are back together.

items.title: A Real Postcard
items.subtitle: By actual post.
items.body: Send them a real postcard with one line on it only they will understand. Tell them nothing. Let it arrive.

items.title: Bold Truths
items.subtitle: Over a call.
items.body: Take turns asking each other bold questions on a call. Answer honestly, or answer with the most suggestive silence you can manage.

items.title: One Word Each
items.subtitle: Build a sentence about them.
items.body: Build a sentence about how much you want them, one word each, taking turns by message. Stop when one of you blushes.

items.title: A Confession by Message
items.subtitle: Easier from far away.
items.body: Send them one confession that is easier to make from a distance: something you have wanted to say or try, and never have.

items.title: Dressed for the Call
items.subtitle: Chosen by them.
items.body: They choose what you wear for your next video call. You wear it with full confidence, and let them look as long as they like.

items.title: A Fantasy, Recorded
items.subtitle: For the nights apart.
items.body: Record a fantasy about your next night together, in your voice, for them to keep for the nights you are apart.

items.title: Game Night Apart
items.subtitle: Online, on a call.
items.body: Play an online game together on a call. The loser writes the winner a flirty poem, delivered by voice message.

items.title: A Night Together, Apart
items.subtitle: All evening, on a call.
items.body: Stay on a call for half an hour and tell each other, slowly and in turn, everything you would do tonight if you were in the same bed.

items.title: Their Rules Tonight
items.subtitle: Set from afar.
items.body: They set three playful rules for your evening alone: something to wear, something to do before bed, something to tell them afterwards.

items.title: A Story in Messages
items.subtitle: One line each.
items.body: Write a story about your next night together, one line each, taking turns by message. It must get bolder with every line.

items.title: All Day Tease
items.subtitle: One message an hour.
items.body: Send one flirty message every hour of their working day. Each one a little bolder. Stop at dinner.

items.title: Midnight Delivery
items.subtitle: Scheduled, bold.
items.body: Schedule a bold message to arrive at midnight describing the moment you will next be alone together. Say nothing else all day.

items.title: Whisper Call
items.subtitle: Only whispers allowed.
items.body: Make a call where you are both only allowed to whisper. Say everything you would say if you were lying next to each other.

items.title: After the Call
items.subtitle: Stay a little longer.
items.body: After a bold call, stay on the line for ten more minutes. Talk about ordinary things until you both feel close again.

items.title: Tell Me the Fantasy
items.subtitle: Live, on a call.
items.body: On a late call, tell each other one fantasy about your next night together, in full, in turn. Neither may interrupt.

items.title: The Bold Game, Apart
items.subtitle: Dares on camera.
items.body: On a video call, take turns choosing bold dares for each other from a list you wrote together. Inside your limits, all night.

items.title: The Letter You Keep
items.subtitle: For the hardest night apart.
items.body: Write them a long, bold letter for the hardest night apart: how much you want them, and exactly what you will do about it.

items.title: The Photo Series
items.subtitle: Three photos, one story.
items.body: Send three photos over an evening that tell a story, each more daring than the last, tasteful and entirely your choice.

items.title: Strangers on the Phone
items.subtitle: Wrong number, right person.
items.body: Call each other as strangers who dialled the wrong number and decided not to hang up. Stay in role until one of you breaks.

items.title: In Sync
items.subtitle: Same song, same time, same thoughts.
items.body: Play the same song at the same moment in two dark rooms. Message each other one sentence each when it ends: exactly what you pictured.

items.title: Unhurried
items.subtitle: The longest voice note.
items.body: Record a voice message as long as you like, telling them everything you want from your next night together. Hold nothing back that you would want them to hear.

items.title: The Door Closes
items.subtitle: As if it had been a month.
items.body: One of you steps outside and comes back in as if you had been apart for a month. Once the door closes, say nothing for one full minute. Let everything else talk.

items.title: The First Night Back
items.subtitle: Plan it together.
items.body: Plan your next night together in detail: the room, the music, what you will wear. Then keep every detail when it comes.

items.title: The Reunion Kiss
items.subtitle: Planned in advance.
items.body: Describe to each other exactly how the hello kiss will go after your next time apart. When the moment comes, make it happen precisely.

items.title: Messages Come True
items.subtitle: Written once, done tonight.
items.body: Scroll back through your messages together and pick the boldest thing either of you ever wrote. Tonight, make it happen exactly as written, inside your limits.

items.title: The First Hour Back
items.subtitle: Plan it now.
items.body: Plan, in detail, the first hour after your next stretch apart: where you will meet, what you will eat, what you will say first.

items.title: No Plans After
items.subtitle: Clear the diary.
items.body: For your next evening together, clear everything after the first hour. Tell them only that, and let them imagine the rest.

items.title: Same Sky
items.subtitle: Look up at the same time.
items.body: Agree a time tonight to step outside and look at the sky together. Send one photo and one sentence about what you are thinking.

items.title: Our Code
items.subtitle: Only you two will know.
items.body: Agree a code emoji that means 'I'm thinking about you in a way I can't write here'. Use it at least once a day this week.

items.title: Fall Quiet Together
items.subtitle: Stay on the line.
items.body: Stay on a call as you both wind down for the night, talking less and less, until one of you says goodnight softly.

items.title: A Song for Tonight
items.subtitle: No explanation needed.
items.body: Send them one song with the message 'listen to this thinking of me'. Tomorrow, ask what they thought you meant by it.

items.title: Three Sealed Evenings
items.subtitle: One envelope a night.
items.body: Post them three sealed envelopes marked for three evenings. Each holds one small, bold task. They open one each night and report back.

items.title: Too Close to Tell
items.subtitle: Bolder clues for wrong guesses.
items.body: Send a photo so close up they cannot tell what it is. They get three guesses, and each wrong guess earns a bolder clue.

items.title: Dressed-Up Video Date
items.subtitle: Make an effort.
items.body: Both dress up as if for a real date, light a candle, and spend half an hour on a video call with nothing else open.

items.title: Tonight, In Your Ear
items.subtitle: Headphones on.
items.body: Record a two-minute voice message for them to listen to alone tonight, with headphones: exactly what you want when you are together next.

items.title: Describe It Slowly
items.subtitle: In your voice, not in text.
items.body: Record a voice message describing, slowly, how you would say hello if you were there tonight. Let your voice do the work.

items.title: Walk Together
items.subtitle: Same time, different streets.
items.body: Go for a walk at the same time, on a call, and describe everything you pass to each other as if the other were beside you.

items.title: Watch Party
items.subtitle: Press play together.
items.body: Pick one episode of a show and press play at exactly the same moment. Message each other your commentary as if you were on the same sofa.

items.title: The Classic Question
items.subtitle: Answer it well.
items.body: Ask them what they are wearing, and answer the same question yourself, in the most flattering and cinematic way possible.

items.title: Accessories First
items.subtitle: They may only watch.
items.body: On a video call, take off one accessory at a time, a watch, a ring, a necklace, as slowly as you possibly can. They may only watch.

items.title: Opposite Corners
items.subtitle: Nobody moves.
items.body: Sit on opposite sides of the room and talk only by message. Describe what you would do if they came closer. Nobody moves until someone gives in.

items.title: What They Would Find
items.subtitle: One unhurried message.
items.body: Send them a message after midnight describing, suggestively and without rushing, what they would find if they were here right now.

items.title: A Bath for Two
items.subtitle: Lights low, one candle.
items.body: Run a bath or a shower for two with the lights low and a single candle. No phones and no talk of the day, only each other.

items.title: Check In Twice
items.subtitle: Nobody mentions real life.
items.body: Book a hotel room, or turn your bedroom into one. Arrive separately, as strangers who have just met. One rule: nobody mentions real life.

items.title: Countdown to Bed
items.subtitle: One message a minute.
items.body: Count down the last ten minutes before bed with one message a minute, each bolder than the last. The final one should keep them up all night.

items.title: Private Dares
items.subtitle: Done in private, reported honestly.
items.body: Trade bold dares by message, one each, done in private and reported honestly afterwards. Either of you may pass once.

items.title: Direct the Kiss
items.subtitle: Then the retake.
items.body: One of you directs the kiss like a film scene: where to start, how slow, when to stop. Then the other directs the retake.

items.title: Dressed to Be Undressed
items.subtitle: One button at a time.
items.body: Get dressed again, on purpose, in something chosen to be taken off. Let them take their time with it, one button at a time.

items.title: Eyes Only
items.subtitle: Close enough to touch.
items.body: Sit close enough to touch, but don't. For three minutes, say everything you want with your eyes alone. The first to reach out loses.

items.title: The Fantasy Letter
items.subtitle: Suggestive, not explicit.
items.body: Write them a letter describing one fantasy in full, suggestive rather than explicit, and send it for them to read alone tonight.

items.title: Follow the Scent
items.subtitle: Three places, eyes closed.
items.body: Wear a scent they have never smelled on you, and put a touch of it in three places. They find all three with their eyes closed.

items.title: Four Songs, No Words
items.subtitle: Everything else is allowed.
items.body: Make a four-song playlist and press play. Until it ends, nobody may speak. Everything else inside your limits is allowed.

items.title: Guess the Kiss
items.subtitle: Five places, one at a time.
items.body: Blindfold them. Kiss them in five places, one at a time, and let them guess each place before the next kiss.

items.title: Halfway Switch
items.subtitle: No pause between.
items.body: One of you leads for ten minutes, then a timer rings and you change places with no pause at all. Try to outdo each other.

items.title: Led by the Hand
items.subtitle: No warning of what comes next.
items.body: Blindfold them for the rest of the evening. Guide them, feed them and kiss them with no warning of what comes next. Check in every few minutes.

items.title: The Kiss Ladder
items.subtitle: Higher, and a little longer.
items.body: Start with a kiss on the hand. Each kiss moves a little higher and lasts a little longer. The first one to hurry loses the round.

items.title: Last Kiss Wins
items.subtitle: Whoever breaks owes a wish.
items.body: Kiss for as long as you can without touching anywhere else. Whoever breaks first owes the other one wish, granted tonight, inside your limits.

items.title: Lights Out
items.subtitle: Find each other in the dark.
items.body: Turn off every light. For five minutes, find each other only by touch and sound, and kiss only when you are sure where they are.

items.title: Midnight Whispers
items.subtitle: One sentence each.
items.body: Ring them at midnight. Speak only in whispers, and write the end of tonight out loud together, one sentence each, back and forth.

items.title: Mirror, Mirror
items.subtitle: Eyes open.
items.body: Stand together at a mirror and watch each other as you kiss. Keep your eyes open for as long as you can bear it.

items.title: My Turn, Your Turn
items.subtitle: One instruction each.
items.body: On a video call, take turns deciding what the other does next, one instruction each, within your limits. Keep going until one of you asks for mercy.

items.title: Never Forgot
items.subtitle: Two people who met once.
items.body: Call each other as two people who met once, years ago, and never forgot it. Tonight one of you finally says why. Stay in the story all the way.

items.title: The Night Clerk
items.subtitle: A late call to reception.
items.body: One of you is a hotel guest calling reception late at night, the other is the night clerk who stays on the line. Stay in character until someone laughs.

items.title: The Night Is Yours
items.subtitle: Every choice, every pace.
items.body: One of you leads the rest of the night, every choice and every pace, inside the limits you agreed in advance. The safe word stops everything, always.

items.title: No Caption
items.subtitle: Let them guess the rest.
items.body: Send one tasteful photo of something you are wearing tonight, no face and no caption. Let them guess what the rest of the evening looks like.

items.title: One Fantasy Each
items.subtitle: Told as a story.
items.body: Share one fantasy each, told as a story in the second person. The listener may ask only one question, and only at the end.

items.title: One Layer, One Word
items.subtitle: Choose the word carefully.
items.body: Agree a word in advance. Each time one of you says it, the other removes one layer. Say it slowly, and make them wait for it.

items.title: One Night Only
items.subtitle: Strangers in your own hallway.
items.body: Meet in your own hallway as strangers. One of you is only in town for one night. See how long it takes before you go inside together.

items.title: One Rule Tonight
items.subtitle: Kept until the night ends.
items.body: One of you sets a single rule for the rest of the night, playful and inside your limits. The other keeps it until the night is over.

items.title: One Slow Song
items.subtitle: Don't let go when it ends.
items.body: Put on one slow song and dance close, with nothing between you but what you are wearing. When the song ends, don't let go.

items.title: One Wish Each
items.subtitle: Grant both.
items.body: Each of you names one wish for the rest of tonight, or for your next night together. Grant both, one after the other.

items.title: Out Loud
items.subtitle: No looking away.
items.body: Tell them, out loud and in detail, the three things about them you find most irresistible. Hold their gaze, or the camera, while you say it.

items.title: Lights Off, Phones On
items.subtitle: The room you wish you were in.
items.body: Call each other in the dark and describe, detail by detail, the room you wish you were in together tonight.

items.title: Pick a Number
items.subtitle: Five sealed messages.
items.body: Write five bold messages and number them. They pick a number, you send that one, and they carry it out before bed, inside your limits.

items.title: A Private Show
items.subtitle: Hands to themselves.
items.body: Put on one song and give them a private show: dance, tease and take your time. They stay seated, hands to themselves, until the song ends.

items.title: Proof
items.subtitle: A photo or a voice note.
items.body: Set each other one bold dare to do alone tonight. Send a tasteful photo as proof, or a voice note describing it if you prefer.

items.title: Read My Lips
items.subtitle: Three tries.
items.body: Mouth one bold sentence silently from across the room. They get three tries to read your lips. If they get it right, it happens.

items.title: Room by Room
items.subtitle: End where the night should.
items.body: Kiss them once in every room of your home, each kiss a little longer than the last. Finish in the room where you want the night to end.

items.title: A Rule From Afar
items.subtitle: Report back in detail.
items.body: Give them one playful rule to keep until you next talk. When you do, they report back on how well they kept it, in detail.

items.title: Say It Back
items.subtitle: Slower each time.
items.body: On a call, they say the boldest sentence they dare, and you repeat it back, slower. Ten sentences, then change roles.

items.title: Say Please
items.subtitle: Every please earns one.
items.body: For the next ten minutes, nothing happens unless it is asked for nicely. Every kiss needs a please, and every please earns a kiss.

items.title: Shadow Play
items.subtitle: One lamp, one song.
items.body: Turn off every light but one lamp behind you. For one song, move slowly and let them watch only your shadow on the wall.

items.title: Slow Motion
items.subtitle: Half speed, no exceptions.
items.body: For ten minutes everything happens at half speed: every kiss, every touch, every word. Whoever rushes starts again from the beginning.

items.title: Stay Close
items.subtitle: Water, blankets, no phones.
items.body: After everything, lie close and tell each other the best moment of tonight. Water, blankets, and no phones until morning.

items.title: A Story for Bed
items.subtitle: Starring the two of you.
items.body: Write them a short bedtime story starring the two of you, suggestive and unhurried, to read alone tonight with the lights down.

items.title: Behind Closed Doors
items.subtitle: The door closing behind you.
items.body: Send them a voice note describing, as slowly as you can bear, the moment the door would close behind the two of you tonight.

items.title: Ten Minutes
items.subtitle: Kissing only, until it rings.
items.body: Set a timer for ten minutes. Until it rings, you may kiss but do nothing else. When it rings, the rest of the night is yours.

items.title: The Chair
items.subtitle: No hurrying allowed.
items.body: They sit in one chair and may not leave it. You have ten minutes and one rule: no hurrying. When time is up, change places.

items.title: The Check-In
items.subtitle: Notes, not judgement.
items.body: Whatever tonight was, end it with a check-in: what was best, what to do again, and anything to leave out next time. No judgement, only notes.

items.title: The Dice
items.subtitle: Six bold moments.
items.body: Write six bold moments on a list and number them. Roll a die, do what it says, and roll again when you are ready, inside your limits, always.

items.title: The Suspect
items.subtitle: Kisses as currency.
items.body: One of you plays a detective, the other a suspect hiding a secret. Questions only, kisses as currency, and the suspect talks only when they choose to.

items.title: The Unsaid Thing
items.subtitle: They reply the same way.
items.body: Record a voice message saying one bold thing you have wanted from them for a long time. They reply the same way before bed.

items.title: Their Pick, Your Outfit
items.subtitle: Unseen until then.
items.body: Send them photos of two outfits for your next night together. They choose one, you wear it without argument, and they don't see it again until then.

items.title: Three Envelopes
items.subtitle: Chosen blind.
items.body: Write three bold ideas for the next hour on slips of paper and fold them. They choose one blind. Whatever it says happens, inside your limits.

items.title: Three Whispers
items.subtitle: One at a time.
items.body: Whisper three things you want tonight into their ear, slowly, one at a time. They may not answer until you have said all three.

items.title: Tonight's Script
items.subtitle: Scene by scene.
items.body: Write the script for your next night together, scene by scene, and send it to them. They may edit one line before they say yes.

items.title: No Clock
items.subtitle: No clock, no plan.
items.body: No clock, no phones, no plan. Take the next half hour as slowly as you both can bear, and speak only to say what feels good.

items.title: Wear It for Me
items.subtitle: Say nothing first.
items.body: Put on the outfit you think they would most like to see, and say nothing. Answer their next video call wearing it, and let them react.

items.title: What I Want Tonight
items.subtitle: Never said out loud.
items.body: Confess one thing you want tonight that you have never said out loud. They answer with yes, not yet, or tell me more.

items.title: Whispered Goodnight
items.subtitle: For them to play in bed.
items.body: Record a whispered voice message for them to play in bed, telling them exactly how you would like to say goodnight in person.

items.title: Words on Skin
items.subtitle: The last word is a promise.
items.body: Trace words slowly on their back with one fingertip. They guess each word. Every right answer earns a kiss, and the last word is a promise.

items.title: Tonight, Your Way
items.subtitle: One directs, one follows.
items.body: One of you directs the next twenty minutes: where to sit, what to wear, when to kiss. The other follows, and either can stop it with your safe word.

items.title: What I Almost Said
items.subtitle: Say it now.
items.body: Tell them about a moment you almost said something important to them and didn't. Then say it now.

items.title: Argue Better
items.subtitle: Agree the pause signal.
items.body: Talk about how you argue. Name one habit each of you would like to change, and agree one signal that means let's pause.

items.title: Ask for It
items.subtitle: Plainly.
items.body: Ask for one thing you need from them, emotional or physical, that you have been waiting for them to guess. Say it plainly.

items.title: Our Best Day
items.subtitle: Pick it in secret.
items.body: Each of you picks your best day together so far without telling the other. Reveal them at the same time. Did you choose the same one?

items.title: Changed My Mind
items.subtitle: Because of them.
items.body: Tell them one opinion you changed because of them, and one you are still quietly hoping to change their mind about.

items.title: Closer
items.subtitle: With and without a touch.
items.body: Tell each other one thing that makes you feel closer to them physically, and one that makes you feel closer without a single touch.

items.title: The Deepest Want
items.subtitle: The one that matters too much.
items.body: Tell them the thing you want most from your life together, the one you rarely say because it matters too much.

items.title: Desire, Then and Now
items.subtitle: What grew, what you miss.
items.body: Talk about how your desire for each other has changed since you met: what has grown, and what you miss from the very beginning.

items.title: My Favourite Version of You
items.subtitle: Specific enough to recognise.
items.body: Describe the version of them you love most: the time of day, the mood, what they are doing. Be specific enough that they recognise it.

items.title: How You Feel Loved
items.subtitle: Guess first.
items.body: Each guess how the other most likes to be shown love. Then say what you really need, and one small thing that would mean more than they think.

items.title: Guess My Answer
items.subtitle: A point for every right guess.
items.body: Ask three questions about yourself, but before you answer, the other must guess what you will say. A point for every right guess.

items.title: The Hardest Week
items.subtitle: And what got you through.
items.body: Talk about the hardest week you have had as a couple, and what each of you did that got you both through it.

items.title: The Honest Letter
items.subtitle: End with a promise.
items.body: Write them an honest letter about where you are as a couple: what is wonderful, what is hard, and what you want next. End with a promise.

items.title: How Would I React?
items.subtitle: Scored out of three.
items.body: Describe three surprising situations. The other predicts exactly how you would react to each. Score every guess out of three.

items.title: The Honest Voice Note
items.subtitle: Honest, not clever.
items.body: Record a voice note with the thing you would say tonight if they were beside you with the lights off. Make it honest, not clever.

items.title: A Letter to Next Year
items.subtitle: Sealed until then.
items.body: Write a letter together to yourselves one year from now: what you hope has changed, and what you hope never will. Seal it.

items.title: The Long Message
items.subtitle: The one you've been composing.
items.body: Write them the long message you have been composing in your head for weeks. Send it without editing it more than once.

items.title: Love, Explained
items.subtitle: No clichés allowed.
items.body: Write them a message explaining exactly why you love them, as if they had asked you to prove it. No clichés allowed.

items.title: A Memory, Told
items.subtitle: As if they weren't there.
items.body: Send them a voice note telling a favourite memory of the two of you, as though describing it to someone who was not there.

items.title: Most at Home
items.subtitle: The time, the place, the light.
items.body: Describe the moment in an ordinary week when you feel most at home with them. Be specific about the time, the place and the light.

items.title: More Of
items.subtitle: Kind and specific.
items.body: Each name one thing you need more of from the relationship, and one thing you could give more of. Keep it kind and specific.

items.title: The Question I Never Asked
items.subtitle: Take a minute before answering.
items.body: Ask them the question you have wanted to ask for a long time and never dared to. They can take a minute before they answer.

items.title: What I Noticed First
items.subtitle: And when you knew.
items.body: Tell each other the first thing you noticed about the other, and the first moment you realised you wanted to see them again.

items.title: An Ordinary Tuesday
items.subtitle: Five years from now.
items.body: Describe an ordinary Tuesday evening together five years from now. Where are you, what are you eating, what are you laughing about?

items.title: Our List
items.subtitle: Ten things, then the first.
items.body: Start a shared list of ten things you want to do together before the end of next year. Pick the first one tonight.

items.title: Our Song, Right Now
items.subtitle: Back to back.
items.body: Each pick one song that sounds like your relationship right now. Play them back to back and explain why you chose it.

items.title: Out of Ten
items.subtitle: What would make it eleven?
items.body: Rate your week together out of ten and explain the score. Then each say what would have made it an eleven.

items.title: The Perfect Sunday
items.subtitle: Hour by hour, for free.
items.body: Plan your perfect lazy Sunday together, hour by hour, with a budget of nothing. Then claim the next free Sunday for it.

items.title: The Private Version
items.subtitle: Almost nobody sees it.
items.body: Tell them about a side of yourself almost nobody sees, and about the last time you let it out.

items.title: A Quiet Hope
items.subtitle: Almost too big to say.
items.body: Tell them one hope for your life together that feels almost too big to say. Then they tell you one of theirs.

items.title: A Small Fear
items.subtitle: No fixing, no advice.
items.body: Share one small fear about the future that you have not said out loud. The listener only listens: no fixing and no advice.

items.title: One Small Regret
items.subtitle: And what they remember.
items.body: Share one small regret from your time together, something you would do differently, and let them tell you what they remember instead.

items.title: The Small Things
items.subtitle: The ones they think you missed.
items.body: Name three small, everyday things they do that make your life better, things they probably think you have never noticed.

items.title: A Thank-You Note
items.subtitle: Overdue, and meant.
items.body: Write them a short thank-you note for something they did that you never properly thanked them for. Send it tonight.

items.title: The Trip We'll Take
items.subtitle: One minute to argue for it.
items.body: Each choose one place in the world to go together and argue for it in under a minute. Whoever wins, the other plans the first day.

items.title: Three Promises
items.subtitle: Practical, romantic, after dark.
items.body: Make each other three promises for the coming year: one practical, one romantic, and one just for the two of you after dark.

items.title: Unfinished Business
items.subtitle: Do it or let it go.
items.body: Name one thing you always meant to do together and never did. Decide tonight whether to do it this month or let it go for good.

items.title: What Distance Does
items.subtitle: Harder, and easier.
items.body: On a call, talk honestly about what time apart does to you: what gets harder, and what surprisingly gets easier.

items.title: What Helps
items.subtitle: On a hard day.
items.body: Tell each other exactly what helps most on a hard day: words, space, food, touch, or something only they would guess.

items.title: What I See
items.subtitle: The parts they doubt included.
items.body: Tell them what you see when you look at them, including the parts they doubt most. Then ask what they see in you.

items.title: What Scares Me About Us
items.subtitle: And what would help.
items.body: Each say one thing that scares you about how much you love them. Then say what would help.

items.title: The Moment of Trust
items.subtitle: That you could trust them.
items.body: Tell each other the moment you knew you could trust them completely, and ask whether they realised it at the time.

items.title: When I Want You Most
items.subtitle: Not in bed.
items.body: Tell each other the specific moments, not in bed, when you want them most: a look, a sentence, a way they move across a room.

items.title: Why That Fantasy
items.subtitle: The feeling, not the details.
items.body: Pick a fantasy one of you has mentioned before and talk about why it appeals: the feeling behind it, not the details.

items.title: What You Taught Me
items.subtitle: On purpose or by accident.
items.body: Tell them one thing they taught you, on purpose or by accident, that you now do without even thinking.
